_comment: 原創翻譯層：上游模組自帶 EN 文本但 As1 未收錄的鍵。人工真相檔（手編或工作流生成後人工審核）。
_usage: schema：entries.<檔名>.<鍵> = {en, ch, cn}。en=擷取當時上游原文（供過時比對）；ch=直寫繁中（不經 OpenCC）；cn=對應簡中。與 As1 同鍵時 As1 優先，build 會提示退役該條目。

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.MeleeBalance_.cn: 防止土匪在上一次近战攻击尚未结束前就发动新的近战攻击

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.RandomLoot_to.en: Percentage of normal chance for each loot item to spawn, 100 = normal
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.RandomLoot_to.ch: 每件戰利品生成機率相對於正常值的百分比，100 = 正常
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.RandomLoot_to.cn: 每件战利品生成几率相对于正常值的百分比，100 = 正常

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.SpawnMultipli.en: Percentage multiplier for the chance that any NPC group will appear; 50 = half, 100 = normal, 200 = double
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.SpawnMultipli.ch: 任何 NPC 隊伍出現機率的百分比倍率；50 = 一半，100 = 正常，200 = 兩倍
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.SpawnMultipli.cn: 任何 NPC 队伍出现几率的百分比倍率；50 = 一半，100 = 正常，200 = 两倍

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.TimePersists.en: Bandits progress based on world age

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.VehicleInsert.ch: 土匪生成時播放車輛音效
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.VehicleInsert.cn: 土匪生成时播放车辆音效

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.ZoneBoost_too.en: Percentage chance for bandit waves to spawn in forage zones they do not prefer
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.ZoneBoost_too.ch: 土匪波次在其不偏好的採集區域生成的百分比機率
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptions.ZoneBoost_too.cn: 土匪波次在其不偏好的采集区域生成的百分比几率

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptionsDay1.Family_to.ch: 遊戲開始時加入的同伴
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptionsDay1.Family_to.cn: 游戏开始时加入的同伴

Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptionsWeek1.Trespass.en: Time before you recieve a violent response for trespassing
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptionsWeek1.Trespass.ch: 擅闖他人領地後遭到武力回擊前的緩衝時間
Sandbox_Bandits_AddOptionsWeek1.Trespass.cn: 擅闯他人领地后遭到武力回击前的缓冲时间

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AbsorbBatchSize_too.en: How many skills/traits/recipes to absorb in a single action when using 'Absorb All'. Higher values complete faster but can cause heavy multiplayer/server desync on busy servers. Set to 1 for classic one-at-a-time behavior. Default: 15
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AbsorbBatchSize_too.ch: 使用「全部領悟」時, 單次操作可領悟的技能/特質/配方數量.數值越高完成越快, 但在繁忙的伺服器上可能造成嚴重的多人/伺服器不同步.設為1則恢復經典的逐一領悟模式.預設: 15.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AbsorbBatchSize_too.cn: 使用“全部学习”时, 单次操作可领悟的技能/特质/配方数量.数值越高完成越快, 但在繁忙的服务器上可能导致严重的多人/服务器不同步.设为1则恢复经典的逐个领悟模式.默认: 15.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowAdaptiveTraits.en: Allow Adaptive Traits Managed Trait Recording

Compatibility toggle for Adaptive Traits (Mod ID: AdaptiveTraits). When disabled (default), AdaptiveTraits-managed traits are hidden from player journal recording and claiming while existing journal data is preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowAdaptiveTraits.ch: 為「動態特質」(模組ID: AdaptiveTraits)提供的相容開關, 停用時 (預設), 該模組管理的特質會從玩家日記的記錄與領取清單中隱藏, 現有日記資料仍會保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowAdaptiveTraits.cn: 为“动态特质”(模组ID: AdaptiveTraits)提供的兼容开关, 禁用时 (默认), 该模组管理的特质会从玩家日记的记录和领取列表中隐藏, 现有日记数据仍会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowDebugCommands_.en: Enables debug commands (/bsjgive, /bsjdump, /bsjdebug, etc.) without requiring the -debug launch flag. In single-player, all players can use them. In multiplayer, any connected player can use them while this option is enabled. Useful for server testing and development.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowDebugCommands_.ch: 啟用模組專屬除錯指令 (/bsjgive, /bsjdump, /bsjdebug等), 無需加上-debug遊戲啟動參數.單人模式下所有玩家皆可使用; 多人模式下, 啟用此選項時任何已連線的玩家皆可使用.適用於伺服器測試與模組開發.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowDebugCommands_.cn: 启用模组专属调试命令 (/bsjgive, /bsjdump, /bsjdebug等), 无需添加-debug游戏启动参数.单人模式下所有玩家均可使用; 多人模式下, 启用此选项时任何已连接的玩家均可使用.适用于服务器测试和模组开发.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.en: Allow ETW Managed Trait Loot Generation
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.ch: 允許生成含 ETW 管理特質的戰利品日記
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.cn: 允许生成含 ETW 管理特质的战利品日记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.en: Compatibility toggle for Evolving Traits World (Mod ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld). When disabled (default), ETW-managed traits are excluded from newly generated worn, bloody, cursed, and yuletide journals while existing journal data is preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.ch: Evolving Traits World(模組 ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld)的相容性選項.停用時 (預設), 由 ETW 管理的特質不會出現在新生成的破舊, 染血, 詛咒與聖誕節日記中, 但現有日記資料會保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.cn: Evolving Traits World(模组 ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld)的兼容性选项.禁用时 (默认), 由 ETW 管理的特质不会出现在新生成的破旧, 染血, 诅咒和圣诞节日记中, 但现有日记数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.ch: 允許記錄 ETW 管理的特質
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.cn: 允许记录 ETW 管理的特质

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.en: Compatibility toggle for Evolving Traits World (Mod ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld). When disabled (default), ETW-managed traits are hidden from player journal recording and claiming while existing journal data is preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.ch: Evolving Traits World(模組 ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld)的相容性選項.停用時 (預設), 由 ETW 管理的特質會在玩家日記的記錄與領取中被隱藏, 但現有日記資料會保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowEvolvingTraits.cn: Evolving Traits World(模组 ID: EvolvingTraitsWorld)的兼容性选项.禁用时 (默认), 由 ETW 管理的特质会在玩家日记的记录与领取中被隐藏, 但现有日记数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowMutualExclusio.en: When claiming a trait that conflicts with one you already have, the conflicting trait is automatically removed.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowMutualExclusio.ch: 領取的特質若與你目前擁有的特質相衝突, 將自動移除已有的衝突特質.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowMutualExclusio.cn: 领取的特质若与你当前拥有的特质存在冲突, 将自动移除已有的冲突特质.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowNegativeTraits.en: If enabled, negative traits (like Clumsy, Slow Learner, etc.) can appear in journals and be recorded. Useful for modded traits or challenge runs. Default: OFF (only positive traits).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowNegativeTraits.ch: 啟用後, 負面特質 (如笨拙, 學習遲鈍等)可出現在日記中並被記錄.適用於模組特質或挑戰模式.預設: 關閉 (僅允許正面特質).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowNegativeTraits.cn: 启用后, 负面特质 (如笨拙, 学习迟钝等)可出现在日记中并被记录.适用于模组特质或挑战模式.默认: 关闭 (仅允许正面特质).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF.en: Allow Others to Claim from Personal Journals
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF.ch: 允許他人領取個人日記獎勵
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF.cn: 允许他人领取个人日记奖励

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF.en: If enabled, other players can claim skills/traits from personal journals they didn't create. Requires 'Allow Others to Open' to be enabled. If disabled, only the author can claim from their own journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF.ch: 啟用後, 玩家可從非自己建立的個人日記中領取技能/特質, 此設定需要先開啟「允許他人開啟個人日記」; 停用後, 僅日記建立者可領取獎勵.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToClaimF.cn: 启用后, 玩家可从非自己创建的个人日记中领取技能/特质, 该设置需要先开启“允许他人打开个人日记”; 禁用后, 仅日记创建者可领取奖励.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo.en: Allow Others to Open Personal Journals
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo.ch: 允許他人開啟個人日記
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo.cn: 允许他人打开个人日记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo.en: If enabled, other players can open and view personal journals they didn't create. If disabled, only the journal's author can open it.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo.ch: 啟用後, 玩家可開啟並檢視非自己建立的個人日記; 關閉後, 僅日記作者可開啟.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowOthersToOpenJo.cn: 启用后, 玩家可打开并查看非自己创建的个人日记; 关闭后, 仅日记作者可打开.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPlayerJournalD.ch: 啟用復原版日記自動消失
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPlayerJournalD.cn: 启用恢复版日记自动消失

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPlayerJournalD.en: Controls whether 'Restored' journals (player journals created from worn/bloody blanks) dissolve after all contents are claimed. Restored journals always display their origin status. Default: OFF (restored journals persist forever like clean journals).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPlayerJournalD.ch: 控制由破舊/血跡斑斑日記翻新而來的「復原版日記」, 在所有內容被領取後是否自動消失.復原版日記會始終顯示其來源狀態.預設: 關閉 (復原版日記與乾淨日記一樣永久保留).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowPlayerJournalD.cn: 控制由破旧/血迹斑斑日记翻新而来的“恢复版日记”, 在所有内容被领取后是否自动消失, 恢复版日记会始终显示其来源标识, 默认: 关闭 (恢复版日记与干净日记一样永久保留).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowTraitPurchaseS.en: Compatibility toggle for Traits Purchase System (Mod ID: TraitsPurchaseSystem). When disabled (default), its trait-currency skills (Traits/Traits1/Traits2/Traits3) are hidden from journal recording and claiming, while existing data remains preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowTraitPurchaseS.ch: 為「特質購買系統」(模組ID: TraitsPurchaseSystem)提供的相容開關, 停用時 (預設), 該模組的特質貨幣類技能 (Traits/Traits1/Traits2/Traits3)會從日記的記錄與領取清單中隱藏, 現有資料仍會保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowTraitPurchaseS.cn: 为“特质购买系统”(模组ID: TraitsPurchaseSystem)提供的兼容开关, 禁用时 (默认), 该模组的特质货币类技能 (Traits/Traits1/Traits2/Traits3)会从日记的记录和领取列表中隐藏, 现有数据仍会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowVhsSkillRecord.ch: 允許記錄錄影帶技能經驗
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowVhsSkillRecord.cn: 允许记录录像带技能经验

Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowVhsSkillRecord.en: Allows player journals to include TV/VHS skill XP. Claimed journal entries mark their recorded media lines as watched to prevent double-dipping.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowVhsSkillRecord.ch: 允許玩家日記記錄電視/錄影帶的技能經驗.已領取的日記條目會將對應的媒體內容標記為已觀看, 以防止重複獲取經驗.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_AllowVhsSkillRecord.cn: 允许玩家日记记录电视/录像带的技能经验.已领取的日记条目会将对应的媒体内容标记为已观看, 以防止重复获取经验.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineRecordingMo.ch: 嚴格僅記錄已賺取進度 (推薦)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineRecordingMo.cn: 严格仅记录已赚取进度 (推荐)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineRecordingMo.en: When Only Record Earned Progress is enabled, this controls how player journals are recorded. Strict Earned Only subtracts baseline starting data from recorded skills, traits, and recipes. Legacy Full Current Data records the character's full current data instead, matching older BSJ behavior. Ignored when Only Record Earned Progress is disabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineRecordingMo.ch: 啟用僅記錄遊戲獲得的進度後, 此設定會控制玩家日記如何記錄.嚴格僅記錄已賺取進度會從已記錄的技能, 特質與配方中扣除基準起始資料.舊版完整目前資料則會改為記錄角色目前的完整資料, 與舊版 BSJ 行為一致.停用僅記錄遊戲獲得的進度時會忽略此設定.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineRecordingMo.cn: 启用仅记录游戏获得的进度后, 此设置会控制玩家日记如何记录.严格仅记录已赚取进度会从记录的技能, 特质和配方中扣除基准起始数据.旧版完整当前数据则会改为记录角色当前的完整数据, 与旧版 BSJ 行为一致.关闭仅记录游戏获得的进度时将忽略此设置.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsAu.ch: 自動儲存基準資料備份
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsAu.cn: 自动保存基准数据备份

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsAu.en: Automatically captures snapshots when baseline data is registered, recovered, or debug-edited.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsAu.ch: 當基準資料備份被註冊, 恢復或透過除錯模式編輯時, 自動儲存新的基準資料備份.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsAu.cn: 当基准数据备份被注册, 恢复或通过调试模式编辑时, 自动保存新的基准数据备份.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsCa.ch: 玩家死亡時儲存基準資料備份
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsCa.cn: 玩家死亡时保存基准数据备份

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsCa.en: When enabled, baseline snapshot lineage is finalized with death metadata during death cleanup.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsCa.ch: 啟用後, 玩家死亡進行資料清理時, 會將死亡時的資料寫入基準資料備份.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsCa.cn: 启用后, 玩家死亡进行数据清理时, 会将死亡时的数据写入基准数据备份.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPe.ch: 每個 SteamID 的快照上限
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPe.cn: 每个 SteamID 的快照上限

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPe.en: Maximum baseline snapshots kept per SteamID before old entries are pruned. Active snapshots are preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPe.ch: 每個 SteamID 可保留的基準資料快照上限, 超出後將刪除舊條目.使用中的快照會被保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPe.cn: 每个 SteamID 可保留的基准数据快照上限, 超出后将删除旧条目.使用中的快照会被保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPr.en: Legacy safety mode. When enabled, applying a snapshot sets debugModified=true (requires manual unlock). Default is OFF for canon restore flow.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPr.ch: 經典安全模式.啟用後, 每次使用備份恢復資料時, 會將角色資料標記為「已被除錯修改」(需要管理員手動解鎖).預設關閉, 以符合標準的恢復流程 (恢復後資料可繼續自動更新).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BaselineSnapshotsPr.cn: 经典安全模式.启用后, 每次使用备份恢复数据时, 会将角色数据标记为‘已被调试修改’(需要管理员手动解锁).默认关闭, 以符合标准的恢复流程 (恢复后数据可继续自动更新).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BatchTimeMultiplier.en: Multiplier for batch action duration. Lower = faster batches. Example: 15 recipes at 0.8s each = 12s normally. With 0.25 multiplier = 3s. Only affects 'Record All' and 'Absorb All', not individual clicks. Default: 0.25 (4x faster)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BatchTimeMultiplier.ch: 批次記錄/領悟操作的耗時倍率, 數值越低批次操作速度越快.範例: 15個配方各耗時0.8秒, 常規總耗時12秒, 0.25倍率下僅需3秒.此設定僅影響「全部記錄」和「全部領悟」, 逐一操作不受影響.預設: 0.25(4倍速).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BatchTimeMultiplier.cn: 批量记录/领悟操作的耗时倍率, 数值越低批量操作速度越快.示例: 15个配方各耗时0.8秒, 常规总耗时12秒, 0.25倍率下仅需3秒.该设置仅影响“全部记录”和“全部学习”, 逐个操作不受影响, 默认: 0.25(4倍速).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalForget.ch: 血跡斑斑日記遺忘槽機率
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalForget.cn: 血迹斑斑日记遗忘槽概率

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalForget.en: Chance for bloody journals to include a special forget slot when bloody forget slots are enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalForget.ch: 啟用血跡斑斑日記遺忘槽時, 血跡斑斑日記包含特殊遺忘槽的機率.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalForget.cn: 启用血迹斑斑日记遗忘槽时, 血迹斑斑日记包含特殊遗忘槽的概率.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxRec.ch: 血跡斑斑日記最大配方數
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxRec.cn: 血迹斑斑日记最大配方数

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxRec.en: Maximum number of magazine recipes that can spawn on a single bloody journal (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxRec.ch: 單本血跡斑斑日記可生成的最大雜誌配方數量 (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxRec.cn: 单本血迹斑斑日记可生成的最大杂志配方数量 (1-5).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxSki.ch: 血跡斑斑日記最多技能數
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxSki.cn: 血迹斑斑日记最多技能数

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxSki.en: Maximum skills in zombie-dropped bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxSki.ch: 殭屍掉落的血跡斑斑日記包含的最多技能數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxSki.cn: 丧尸掉落的血迹斑斑日记包含的最多技能数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxTra.ch: 單本血跡斑斑日記最多特質數
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxTra.cn: 单本血迹斑斑日记最多特质数

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxTra.en: Maximum number of traits that can spawn on a single bloody journal (0-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxTra.ch: 單本血跡斑斑日記可生成的最多特質數量 (0-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxTra.cn: 单本血迹斑斑日记可生成的最多特质数量 (0-5).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxXP.ch: 血跡斑斑日記單技能最大 XP
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxXP.cn: 血迹斑斑日记单技能最大 XP

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxXP_.en: Maximum XP per skill in bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxXP_.ch: 血跡斑斑日記中每項技能的最大 XP.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMaxXP_.cn: 血迹斑斑日记中每项技能的最大 XP.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMinSki.ch: 血跡斑斑日記最少技能數
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMinSki.cn: 血迹斑斑日记最少技能数

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalMinSki.en: Minimum skills in zombie-dropped bloody journals.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalRecipe.cn: 血迹斑斑日记包含杂志配方的概率 (0-100%), 设为0则新生成的血迹斑斑日记无配方.血迹斑斑日记的概率高于破旧日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalSpawnC.cn: 血迹斑斑日记掉落概率

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalSpawnC.ch: 殭屍掉落血跡斑斑日記的機率 (0.1-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalSpawnC.cn: 丧尸掉落血迹斑斑日记的概率 (0.1-100%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalTraitC.en: Chance for bloody journals to spawn with traits (0-100%). Set to 0% to prevent traits from spawning on new journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalTraitC.ch: 血跡斑斑日記生成時附帶特質的機率 (0-100%), 設為0則新生成的血跡斑斑日記無特質.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalTraitC.cn: 血迹斑斑日记生成时附带特质的概率 (0-100%), 设为0则新生成的血迹斑斑日记无特质.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_ConvertTime_tooltip.en: Time in seconds to convert a worn journal to a clean journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ConvertTime_tooltip.ch: 將破舊日記翻新為乾淨日記所需的耗時 (秒).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ConvertTime_tooltip.cn: 将破旧日记翻新为干净日记所需的耗时 (秒).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalExpira.en: In-game days before a cursed journal's curse goes dormant. Expired cursed journals still open into bloody reward journals, but no curse fires.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalExpira.ch: 詛咒日記的詛咒進入休眠前所需的遊戲內天數.過期的詛咒日記開啟後仍會變成血跡斑斑獎勵日記, 但不會觸發詛咒.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalExpira.cn: 诅咒日记的诅咒进入休眠前所需的游戏内天数.过期的诅咒日记打开后仍会变成血迹斑斑奖励日记, 但不会触发诅咒.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalForget.en: Chance for cursed reward journals to include a forget slot when cursed forget slots are enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalForget.ch: 啟用詛咒遺忘槽時, 詛咒獎勵日記包含遺忘槽的機率.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalForget.cn: 启用诅咒遗忘槽时, 诅咒奖励日记包含遗忘槽的概率.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 詛咒洞察揭露精確效果
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 诅咒洞察揭露精确效果

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.en: When enabled, survivors meeting the Exact insight threshold can identify the specific curse effect in item hover tooltips and Breaking the Seal confirmation prompts.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 啟用後, 達到精確洞察門檻的倖存者可在物品懸停提示與打破封印的確認提示中辨識具體詛咒效果.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 启用后, 达到精确洞察门槛的幸存者可在确认阅读前辨识具体诅咒效果.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 詛咒洞察精確搜尋等級
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 诅咒洞察精确搜寻等级

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.en: Foraging level used for exact curse insight when exact effect insight is enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 啟用精確效果洞察時, 用於精確詛咒洞察的搜尋等級.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 启用精确效果洞察时, 用于精确诅咒洞察的搜寻等级.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 詛咒洞察預兆搜尋等級
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 诅咒洞察预兆搜寻等级

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.en: Foraging level that, with Cat's Eyes, Herbalist, or Park Ranger fieldcraft, gives Aware insight and reveals the curse's broad omen category.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 此搜尋等級搭配貓眼, 草藥學家或公園巡邏員的野外求生技藝時, 可獲得預兆洞察並揭露詛咒的大致預兆類別.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 搭配猫眼, 草药学家或公园巡逻员的野外经验时, 可揭露诅咒大致预兆类别的搜寻等级.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 詛咒洞察揭露搜尋等級
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 诅咒洞察揭露搜寻等级

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.en: Foraging level for Hint insight, letting survivors notice hidden-cursed journals. Cat's Eyes and fieldcraft traits can also reveal suspicious journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.ch: 用於揭露洞察的搜尋等級, 讓倖存者能察覺隱藏的詛咒日記. 貓眼與野外求生特質也能揭露可疑日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalInsigh.cn: 让幸存者察觉隐藏诅咒日记的搜寻等级.猫眼与野外求生特质也能揭露可疑日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLosePo.ch: 詛咒移除正面特質權重
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLosePo.cn: 诅咒移除正面特质权重

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLosePo.en: Relative weight for the severe cursed penalty that removes a positive trait. Lower values make this punishment rarer.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLosePo.ch: 嚴重詛咒懲罰的相對權重: 移除一個正面特質. 數值越低, 這種懲罰越少見.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLosePo.cn: 严重诅咒惩罚的相对权重: 移除一个正面特质.数值越低, 这种惩罚越少见.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLoseSk.en: Relative weight for the severe cursed penalty that removes a skill level. Lower values make this punishment rarer.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLoseSk.ch: 嚴重詛咒懲罰的相對權重: 移除一個技能等級. 數值越低, 這種懲罰越少見.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalLoseSk.cn: 严重诅咒惩罚的相对权重: 移除一个技能等级.数值越低, 这种惩罚越少见.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxRec.en: Maximum recipes generated on cursed reward journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxRec.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記生成的最多配方數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxRec.cn: 诅咒奖励日记生成的最多配方数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxSki.en: Maximum skills generated on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxSki.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記生成的最多技能數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxSki.cn: 解封后的诅咒奖励日记包含的最多技能数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxTra.en: Maximum traits generated on cursed reward journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxTra.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記生成的最多特質數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxTra.cn: 诅咒奖励日记特质随机生成成功时, 诅咒奖励日记可生成的最多特质数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxXP.ch: 詛咒日記最大 XP/技能
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxXP.cn: 诅咒日记最大 XP/技能

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxXP_.en: Maximum XP per skill on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxXP_.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記上每項技能的最大 XP.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMaxXP_.cn: 诅咒奖励日记上的每项技能最多 XP.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinSki.en: Minimum skills generated on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinSki.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記生成的最少技能數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinSki.cn: 解封后的诅咒奖励日记包含的最少技能数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinTra.en: Minimum traits generated on cursed reward journals when trait roll succeeds.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinTra.ch: 特質判定成功時, 詛咒獎勵日記生成的最少特質數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinTra.cn: 诅咒奖励日记特质随机生成成功时, 诅咒奖励日记可生成的最少特质数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinXP.ch: 詛咒日記最小 XP/技能
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinXP.cn: 诅咒日记最小 XP/技能

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinXP_.en: Minimum XP per skill on a cursed reward journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinXP_.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記上每項技能的最低 XP.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalMinXP_.cn: 诅咒奖励日记上的每项技能最低 XP.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNegati.en: Relative weight for the softer cursed penalty that adds a negative trait. Higher values make it more likely when a cursed journal opens.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNegati.ch: 較輕詛咒懲罰的相對權重: 新增一個負面特質. 數值越高, 開啟詛咒日記時越容易發生.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNegati.cn: 较轻诅咒惩罚的相对权重: 添加一个负面特质.数值越高, 打开诅咒日记时越容易发生.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNoteCh.en: Chance for newly spawned cursed reward journals to include a generated read-only occult note page.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNoteCh.ch: 新生成的詛咒獎勵日記包含自動生成的唯讀神秘筆記頁的機率.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalNoteCh.cn: 新生成的诅咒奖励日记包含生成式只读神秘笔记页的概率.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalRecipe.en: Chance for cursed reward journals to include recipes (0-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalRecipe.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記包含配方的機率(0-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalRecipe.cn: 诅咒奖励日记包含配方的概率 (0-100%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.ch: 詛咒嚴重重複抑制期(小時)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.cn: 诅咒严重重复窗口 (小时)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.en: How long recent severe cursed penalties continue suppressing more severe repeats for the same player. Set to 0 to disable the repeat window.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.ch: 同一玩家最近的嚴重詛咒懲罰會在多久內持續抑制後續的嚴重重複. 設為 0 可停用此抑制期.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.cn: 同一玩家最近的严重诅咒惩罚会在多久内抑制更多严重重复.设为 0 可禁用重复窗口.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.en: After a recent severe curse, this is the percent of normal chance retained by severe penalties like losing positive traits or skill levels. Set to 0 to nearly hard-lock repeats, or 100 to disable this cooldown.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.ch: 最近發生嚴重詛咒後, 移除正面特質或技能等級等嚴重懲罰所保留的正常機率百分比. 設為 0 可近乎完全鎖定重複, 設為 100 可停用此冷卻.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.cn: 最近发生严重诅咒后, 移除正面特质或技能等级等严重惩罚保留的正常概率百分比.设为 0 可近似锁定重复, 设为 100 可禁用冷却.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.en: Extra percent of skill XP granted by a cursed reward journal when the applied curse was severe. Only applies when Cursed Severity Compensation is enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.ch: 當施加的詛咒為嚴重詛咒時, 詛咒獎勵日記額外給予的技能 XP 百分比. 僅在啟用詛咒嚴重度補償時生效.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSevere.cn: 当施加的诅咒为严重诅咒时, 诅咒奖励日记额外给予的技能 XP 百分比.仅在启用诅咒严重度补偿时生效.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSeveri.en: When a cursed journal inflicts a persistent or severe penalty, guarantee a forget slot and (for severe curses) richer skill rewards to keep opening worthwhile.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSeveri.ch: 當詛咒日記施加持久或嚴重懲罰時, 保證生成遺忘槽, 並為嚴重詛咒提供更豐厚的技能獎勵, 讓開啟仍有價值.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSeveri.cn: 当诅咒日记施加持久或严重惩罚时, 保证生成遗忘槽, 并为严重诅咒提供更丰厚的技能奖励, 让开启仍有价值.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSpawnC.en: Chance for a zombie to drop a cursed journal (0-100%). If this rolls, normal bloody drop is skipped for that zombie.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSpawnC.ch: 殭屍掉落詛咒日記的機率(0-100%). 若此判定成功, 該殭屍將不會掉落普通的血跡斑斑日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalSpawnC.cn: 击杀丧尸后, 丧尸掉落诅咒日记的概率 (0-100%), 若此次掉落判定成功, 该丧尸将不会掉落普通的血迹斑斑日记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalTraitC.en: Chance for cursed reward journals to include traits (0-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalTraitC.ch: 詛咒獎勵日記包含特質的機率(0-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_CursedJournalTraitC.cn: 诅咒奖励日记包含特质的概率 (0-100%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingDecayRat.ch: 每次閱讀經驗衰減比例 %
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingDecayRat.cn: 每次阅读经验衰减比例 %

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingDecayRat.en: XP reduction for each subsequent read (5-50%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingDecayRat.ch: 每次後續閱讀的 XP 減少幅度 (5-50%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingDecayRat.cn: 每次后续读取的 XP 减少 (5-50%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingFirstRea.en: XP percentage on first read (50-100%). Only applies with Diminishing Returns.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingFirstRea.ch: 首次閱讀時的 XP 百分比 (50-100%). 僅在收益遞減啟用時適用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingFirstRea.cn: 首次读取时的 XP 百分比 (50-100%).仅适用于收益递减.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingMinimum_.en: Floor percentage that recovery cannot go below (0-50%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingMinimum_.ch: 經驗回復的比例下限(0-50%), 無法低於該值.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingMinimum_.cn: 经验恢复的最低比例下限 (0-50%), 无法低于该值.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingTracking.en: How diminishing returns are tracked for CLEAN journal skill claims when Diminishing Returns is enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingTracking.ch: 啟用收益遞減時, 清潔日記技能領取的收益遞減追蹤方式.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DiminishingTracking.cn: 启用收益递减模式后, 干净日记技能领取的收益递减计算规则.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DisguiseCursedJourn.ch: 將詛咒日記偽裝成血跡斑斑日記
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DisguiseCursedJourn.cn: 将诅咒日记伪装成血迹斑斑日记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_DisguiseCursedJourn.en: When enabled, cursed zombie drops appear as ordinary bloody journals until first open. The curse springs immediately on that first open instead of showing a sealed warning prompt.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DisguiseCursedJourn.ch: 啟用後, 殭屍掉落的詛咒日記在首次開啟前會顯示為普通的血跡斑斑日記. 詛咒會在首次開啟時立即發作, 而不會顯示封印警告提示.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_DisguiseCursedJourn.cn: 启用后, 丧尸掉落的诅咒日记在首次打开之前会显示为普通的血迹斑斑日记.诅咒在第一次打开时立即弹出, 而不是显示封印警告提示.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableAnimatedJourn.ch: 啟用動畫日記視覺效果
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableAnimatedJourn.cn: 启用动画日记视觉效果

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableAnimatedJourn.en: Allows animated journal backgrounds and future animated journal effects in the UI. Disable this to keep journal visuals static.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableAnimatedJourn.ch: 允許在 UI 中使用動畫日記背景與未來的動畫日記效果. 停用此選項可讓日記視覺效果保持靜態.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableAnimatedJourn.cn: 允许在 UI 中使用动画日记背景和未来的动画日记效果.禁用此选项可保持日记视觉效果静态.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineRestr.ch: 僅記錄遊戲中獲得的進度
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineRestr.cn: 仅记录游戏获得的进度

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineRestr.en: When enabled, journals only record XP earned through gameplay - not profession starting bonuses or trait skill boosts. This prevents exploits where players farm profession skills by creating multiple characters. Recommended ON for multiplayer servers.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineRestr.ch: 啟用後, 日記僅記錄透過遊戲實際獲得的 XP, 而非職業起始加成或特質技能加成. 這可防止玩家藉由建立多個角色來刷職業技能的漏洞. 建議多人伺服器開啟.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineRestr.cn: 启用后, 日记仅记录通过游戏获得的 XP - 而不是职业起始奖金或特质技能提升.这可以防止玩家通过创建多个角色来培养职业技能的漏洞.建议多人服务器开启.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineSnaps.en: When enabled, BSJ stores SteamID-anchored baseline snapshots for admin recovery and rollback safety.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineSnaps.ch: 啟用後, BSJ 會儲存以 SteamID 錨定的基準資料快照, 供管理員復原與回溯保障使用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBaselineSnaps.cn: 启用后, BSJ 会存储 SteamID 锚定的基准数据快照, 以实现管理恢复和回滚安全.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 啟用血跡斑斑日記遺忘槽
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 启用血迹斑斑日记遗忘槽

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.en: When enabled, bloody journals may spawn with a claimable forget slot.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 啟用後, 血跡斑斑日記可能生成一個可領取的遺忘槽.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 启用后, 血迹斑斑日记可能生成一个可领取的遗忘槽.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 啟用血跡斑斑日記配方
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 启用血迹斑斑日记配方

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.en: When enabled, recipes can be claimed from bloody journals. When disabled, recipes tab will be hidden on bloody journals but existing recipe data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 啟用後可從血跡斑斑日記領取配方. 停用後血跡斑斑日記的配方標籤將隱藏, 但現有配方資料會保留, 重新啟用時可繼續使用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 启用后可从血迹斑斑日记中领取配方.禁用后配方标签将隐藏, 但现有配方数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: II. 啟用血跡斑斑日記掉落
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: II. 启用血迹斑斑日记掉落

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.en: Allow zombies to drop bloody journals. These offer better rewards and rare traits.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 允許殭屍掉落血跡斑斑日記, 這類日記提供更豐厚的獎勵和稀有特質.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 允许丧尸掉落血迹斑斑日记, 这类日记提供更丰厚的奖励和稀有特质.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 啟用血跡斑斑日記特質
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 启用血迹斑斑日记特质

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.en: When enabled, traits can be claimed from bloody journals. When disabled, traits tab will be hidden on bloody journals but existing trait data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.ch: 啟用後可從血跡斑斑日記領取特質. 停用後血跡斑斑日記的特質標籤將隱藏, 但現有特質資料會保留, 重新啟用時可繼續使用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableBloodyJournal.cn: 启用后可从血迹斑斑日记中领取特质.禁用后特质标签将隐藏, 但现有特质数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: When enabled, cursed journals older than the expiration age open safely without applying a curse.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 啟用後, 超過失效期限的詛咒日記可安全開啟, 不會施加詛咒.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 启用后, 超过失效期限的诅咒日记可安全打开, 不会施加诅咒.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: When enabled, cursed reward journals may generate a claimable forget slot.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 啟用後, 詛咒獎勵日記可能生成一個可領取的遺忘槽.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 启用后, 诅咒奖励日记可能生成一个可领取的遗忘槽.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: Allows perceptive survivors to notice disguised cursed journals and read escalating Hint, Aware, and Exact curse warnings from Cat's Eyes, Foraging, Herbalist, and fieldcraft backgrounds.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 允許感知敏銳的倖存者察覺偽裝的詛咒日記, 並透過貓眼, 搜尋, 草藥學家與野外求生背景, 讀出逐級升高的揭露, 預兆與精確詛咒警示.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 允许感知敏锐的幸存者察觉伪装的诅咒日记, 并通过猫眼, 搜寻, 草药学家与野外求生背景读出更强的诅咒警示.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: When enabled, opening a cursed journal reveals an omen hinting at the curse category (pain, ruin, or loss) and constrains the curse to that category.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 啟用後, 開啟詛咒日記會顯現預兆, 暗示詛咒的類別(疼痛, 毀損或喪失), 並將詛咒限制在該類別內.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 启用后, 打开诅咒日记会揭示预兆, 暗示诅咒的类别 (疼痛, 毁损或丧失), 并将诅咒限制在该类别内.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 啟用詛咒日記配方領取
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 启用诅咒日记配方领取

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: When enabled, cursed reward journals can generate and allow recipe claims.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 啟用後, 解封的詛咒獎勵日記可生成配方並允許領取.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 启用后, 解封后的诅咒奖励日记可生成配方并允许领取.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: I. 啟用詛咒日記掉落
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: I. 启用诅咒日记掉落

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: Allow zombies to rarely drop dormant cursed journals. The first opener is cursed, then the journal becomes a richer bloody reward.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 允許殭屍小機率掉落休眠的詛咒日記. 首位開啟者會受到詛咒, 之後該日記會變成獎勵更豐厚的血跡斑斑日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 允许丧尸小概率掉落封印的诅咒日记, 首个打开该日记的玩家会受到诅咒, 之后该日记会解封为奖励更丰厚的血迹斑斑日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.en: When enabled, cursed reward journals can generate and allow trait claims.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.ch: 啟用後, 詛咒獎勵日記可生成特質並允許領取.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableCursedJournal.cn: 启用后, 诅咒奖励日记可生成特质并允许领取.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableJournals_tool.en: Master toggle for the entire survival journals system.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableJournals_tool.ch: 整個生存日記系統的總開關.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableJournals_tool.cn: 生存日记整个系统的总开关.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLimitedClaimL.ch: 啟用有限領取戰利品日記
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLimitedClaimL.cn: 启用有限领取战利品日记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLimitedClaimL.en: When enabled, worn, bloody, and cursed reward journals dissolve after a limited number of successful claims. Already-known or blocked claims do not consume the limit.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLimitedClaimL.ch: 啟用後, 破舊, 血跡斑斑與被詛咒的獎勵日記會在有限次數的成功領取後消失. 已知或被阻擋的領取不會消耗該次數上限.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLimitedClaimL.cn: 启用后, 破旧的, 血迹斑斑的和被诅咒的奖励日记会在有限数量的成功领取后消失.已知或被阻止的领取不会消耗该限额.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalNo.ch: 啟用生成的戰利品日記筆記
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalNo.cn: 启用生成的战利品日记笔记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalNo.en: Allow newly spawned loot journals to sometimes include read-only generated lore notes. Existing discovered journals are not retroactively given notes.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalNo.ch: 允許新生成的戰利品日記有時包含唯讀的生成式劇情筆記.已經發現的日記不會被追溯加入筆記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalNo.cn: 允许新生成的战利品日记有时包含只读的生成式剧情笔记.已经发现的日记不会被追溯添加笔记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalsF.en: Master toggle for fun loot journals. When disabled, cursed and Yuletide journal spawns and seasonal fun-journal hooks are turned off.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalsF.ch: 趣味戰利品日記的總開關.停用後, 詛咒日記與聖誕節日記將不再生成, 季節性趣味日記掛鉤也會關閉.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableLootJournalsF.cn: 有趣战利品日记的总开关.禁用后, 诅咒日记和圣诞节日记将不再生成, 季节性有趣日记挂钩也会关闭.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.en: When enabled, Fitness/Strength can appear and be claimed on worn/bloody journals. When disabled, passive skill entries are hidden but preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.ch: 啟用後, 體格和力量這兩個被動技能可出現在破舊/血跡斑斑的日記中並領取; 停用後, 被動技能的條目會隱藏, 但現有資料會保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.cn: 启用后, 体格和力量这两个被动技能可出现在破旧/血迹斑斑的日记中并领取; 禁用后, 被动技能的条目会隐藏, 但现有数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.ch: 啟用被動技能記錄 (玩家日記)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.cn: 启用被动技能记录 (玩家日记)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.en: When enabled, Fitness/Strength can be recorded and claimed from player journals. When disabled, passive skill entries are hidden but preserved.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.ch: 啟用後, 體格和力量這兩個被動技能可在玩家日記中記錄並領取; 停用後, 被動技能的條目會隱藏, 但現有資料會保留.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePassiveSkills.cn: 启用后, 体格和力量这两个被动技能可在玩家日记中记录并领取; 禁用后, 被动技能的条目会隐藏, 但现有数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.ch: 啟用玩家日記製作/轉化
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.cn: 启用玩家日记制作/转化

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.en: Allow crafting/restore conversion recipes for personal journals. Disable to prevent journal crafting while still allowing reading/claiming from existing player journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.ch: 允許玩家透過配方製作個人日記, 或將破舊日記轉化為乾淨日記; 停用後將無法製作/轉化, 但仍可閱讀並領取現有玩家日記的內容.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.cn: 允许玩家通过配方制作个人日记, 或将破旧日记转化为干净日记; 禁用后将无法制作/转化, 但仍可阅读并领取现有玩家日记的内容.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.en: Allow players to write freeform note pages in personal journals. Existing notes remain readable when this is disabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.ch: 允許玩家在個人日記中書寫自由格式的筆記頁.停用後, 已有筆記仍可閱讀.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.cn: 允许玩家在个人日记中书写自由格式的笔记页.禁用后, 已有笔记仍可阅读.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.en: Allow players to use personal journals for recording/recovering skills. Disable to block player-journal interactions entirely.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.ch: 允許玩家使用個人日記來記錄/恢復技能.停用後將完全阻止玩家日記的互動.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnablePlayerJournal.cn: 允许玩家使用个人日记来记录/恢复技能.禁用后将完全阻止玩家日记的交互.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableRecipeRecordi.ch: 啟用配方記錄 (玩家日記)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableRecipeRecordi.cn: 启用配方记录 (玩家日记)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableRecipeRecordi.en: Allow players to record magazine-learned recipes in their personal journals. When disabled, the recipes tab will be hidden and existing recipes will be preserved but inaccessible.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableRecipeRecordi.ch: 允許玩家在個人日記中記錄從雜誌學會的配方.停用後, 配方標籤頁將隱藏, 現有配方資料會保留但無法存取.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableRecipeRecordi.cn: 允许玩家在个人日记中记录从杂志学会的配方.禁用后, 配方标签将隐藏, 现有配方数据会保留但无法访问.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableStatRecording.en: Master toggle for recording player stats (kills, survival time, etc.) in personal journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableStatRecording.ch: 在個人日記中記錄玩家狀態 (擊殺數, 生存時長等)的總開關.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableStatRecording.cn: 在个人日记中记录玩家状态 (击杀数, 生存时长等)的总开关.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableTraitRecordin.ch: 啟用特質記錄 (玩家日記)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableTraitRecordin.cn: 启用特质记录 (玩家日记)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableTraitRecordin.en: Allow players to record traits in their personal journals. When disabled, the traits tab will be hidden in player journals and existing traits will be preserved but inaccessible.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableTraitRecordin.ch: 允許玩家在個人日記中記錄特質.停用後, 玩家日記的特質標籤頁將隱藏, 現有特質資料會保留但無法存取.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableTraitRecordin.cn: 允许玩家在个人日记中记录特质.禁用后, 玩家日记的特质标签将隐藏, 现有特质数据会保留但无法访问.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableVanillaJourna.ch: 啟用原版筆記本和日記製作
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableVanillaJourna.cn: 启用原版笔记本和日记制作

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableVanillaJourna.en: Allow BSJ to add crafting recipes for vanilla Notebook and Journal items. Disable to hide these recipes while keeping existing vanilla items usable.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableVanillaJourna.ch: 允許 BSJ 為原版筆記本和日記物品加入製作配方.停用後會隱藏這些配方, 但已有的原版物品仍可使用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableVanillaJourna.cn: 允许 BSJ 为原版笔记本和日记物品添加制作配方.禁用后会隐藏这些配方, 但已有的原版物品仍可使用.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalFo.ch: 啟用破舊日記遺忘槽位
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalFo.cn: 启用破旧日记遗忘槽位

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalFo.en: When enabled, worn journals may spawn with a claimable forget slot.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalFo.ch: 啟用後, 破舊日記可能生成一個可領取的遺忘槽位.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalFo.cn: 启用后, 破旧日记可能生成一个可领取的遗忘槽位.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalRe.en: When enabled, recipes can be claimed from worn journals. When disabled, recipes tab will be hidden on worn journals but existing recipe data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalRe.ch: 啟用後可從破舊日記中領取配方.停用後配方標籤頁將隱藏, 但現有配方資料會保留, 重新啟用時可再使用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalRe.cn: 启用后可从破旧日记中领取配方.禁用后配方标签将隐藏, 但现有配方数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalSp.ch: I. 啟用破舊日記生成
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalSp.cn: I. 启用破旧日记生成

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalSp.en: Allow worn journals to spawn in world containers (shelves, desks, cabinets). These offer light XP rewards.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalSp.ch: 允許破舊日記在世界容器 (架子, 桌子, 櫃子)中生成.這些提供少量的 XP 獎勵.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalSp.cn: 允许破旧日记在世界容器 (架子, 桌子, 柜子)中生成.这些提供了少量的 XP 奖励.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalTr.en: When enabled, traits can be claimed from worn journals. When disabled, traits tab will be hidden on worn journals but existing trait data is preserved for when re-enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalTr.ch: 啟用後可從破舊日記中領取特質.停用後特質標籤頁將隱藏, 但現有特質資料會保留, 重新啟用時可再使用.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableWornJournalTr.cn: 启用后可从破旧日记中领取特质.禁用后特质标签将隐藏, 但现有特质数据会保留.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.en: Allow Yuletide journals to roll the forget-slot reward.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.ch: 允許聖誕節日記擲出遺忘槽位獎勵.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.cn: 允许圣诞节日记生成遗忘槽位奖励.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.en: When enabled, Yuletide journals can include claimable recipes.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.ch: 啟用後, 聖誕節日記可以包含可領取的配方.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.cn: 启用后, 圣诞节日记可以包含可领取的配方.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.en: Allow seasonal Yuletide journals to replace some worn and bloody journals when the Yuletide season is active.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.ch: 在聖誕節季節期間, 允許季節性聖誕節日記取代部分破舊和血跡斑斑的日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.cn: 当圣诞节季节活跃时, 允许季节性圣诞节日记替换一些破旧和血迹斑斑的日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.en: When enabled, Yuletide journals can include claimable traits.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.ch: 啟用後, 聖誕節日記可以包含可領取的特質.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideJourn.cn: 启用后, 圣诞节日记可以包含可领取的特质.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideKramp.ch: 僅限十二月 (主機現實月份)
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideKramp.cn: 仅限十二月 (主机现实月份)

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideKramp.en: Controls when newly spawned cursed journals use Krampus as their author identity. This is separate from Yuletide journal spawn timing.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideKramp.ch: 控制新生成的詛咒日記何時以坎卜斯作為作者身分.這與聖誕節日記的生成時機是分開的.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EnableYuletideKramp.cn: 控制新生成的诅咒日记何时以坎卜斯作为作者身份.这与圣诞节日记的生成时机是分开的.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_EraseTime_tooltip.en: Time in seconds to erase a journal's contents.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EraseTime_tooltip.ch: 清空日記內容所需的耗時 (秒).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_EraseTime_tooltip.cn: 清空日记内容所需的耗时 (秒).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_ExcludePassiveSkill.ch: 排除自動管理的身體特質
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ExcludePassiveSkill.cn: 排除自动管理的身体特质

Sandbox_BurdJournals_ExcludePassiveSkill.en: If enabled, journals will not record or grant traits automatically managed by Fitness, Strength, or body weight changes: Unfit, Out of Shape, Fit, Athletic, Puny, Weak, Feeble, Stout, Strong, Overweight, Obese, Underweight, Very Underweight, and Emaciated. Default: ON.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ExcludePassiveSkill.ch: 啟用後, 日記不會記錄或授予由體格, 力量或體重變化自動管理的特質: 身體很差, 身體不好, 身體健康, 運動健將, 弱不禁風, 身體虛弱, 身體壯碩, 身強力壯, 體重過重, 身肥體胖, 體重過輕, 身形消瘦, 瘦骨嶙峋.預設: 開啟.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ExcludePassiveSkill.cn: 启用后, 日记不会记录或授予由体格, 力量或体重变化自动管理的特质: 身体很差, 身体不好, 身体健康, 运动健将, 弱不禁风, 身体虚弱, 身体壮硕, 身强力壮, 体重过重, 身肥体胖, 体重过轻, 身形消瘦, 瘦骨嶙峋.默认: 开启.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalUIPagination.ch: 日記 UI 分頁閾值
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalUIPagination.cn: 日记 UI 分页阈值

Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalUIPagination.en: How many entries a journal tab can show on one page before pagination appears. Lower values reduce UI load but split long lists into more pages.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalUIPagination.ch: 日記標籤頁在出現分頁前單頁可顯示的條目數量.較低數值可降低 UI 負載, 但會把長清單分成更多頁.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalUIPagination.cn: 日记标签页在分页出现前单页可显示的条目数量.较低数值可降低 UI 负载, 但会把长列表分成更多页.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalXPMultiplier.en: Multiplier for XP gained from journals (0.25 = 25%, 1.0 = 100%, 2.0 = 200%). Applies to both worn and bloody journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalXPMultiplier.ch: 從日記獲得的 XP 乘數 (0.25 = 25%, 1.0 = 100%, 2.0 = 200%).適用於破舊和血跡斑斑的日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_JournalXPMultiplier.cn: 从日记获得的 XP 乘数 (0.25 = 25%, 1.0 = 100%, 2.0 = 200%).适用于破旧和血迹斑斑的日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimeMultipl.en: Global multiplier for all learning times. 0.5 = twice as fast, 2.0 = twice as slow.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimeMultipl.ch: 所有學習耗時的全域倍率.0.5 = 耗時減半, 2.0 = 耗時翻倍.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimeMultipl.cn: 所有学习耗时的全局倍率.0.5 = 耗时减半, 2.0 = 耗时翻倍.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerReci.en: Base time in seconds to learn each recipe from a journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerReci.ch: 從日記中學習每個配方的基礎耗時 (秒).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerReci.cn: 从日记中学习每个配方的基础耗时 (秒).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerSkil.en: Base time in seconds to learn each skill from a journal. Simulates reading/studying.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerSkil.ch: 從日記中學習每個技能的基礎耗時 (秒), 模擬閱讀/鑽研的過程.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerSkil.cn: 从日记中学习每个技能的基础耗时 (秒), 模拟阅读/钻研的过程.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerTrai.en: Base time in seconds to absorb each trait from a journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerTrai.ch: 從日記中領悟每個特質的基礎耗時 (秒).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LearningTimePerTrai.cn: 从日记中领悟每个特质的基础耗时 (秒).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_LootJournalMaxClaim.en: Loot Journal Max Claims Before Dissolve
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LootJournalMaxClaim.ch: 戰利品日記消失前最大領取次數
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LootJournalMaxClaim.cn: 战利品日记消失前最大领取次数

Sandbox_BurdJournals_LootJournalMaxClaim.en: Global cap for how many successful rewards a player can claim from a single worn, bloody, or cursed reward journal before it dissolves. Only applies when limited-claim loot journals are enabled. Default: 1
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LootJournalMaxClaim.ch: 玩家可從單本破舊, 血跡斑斑或詛咒獎勵日記中成功領取多少獎勵的全域上限, 達到後日記即消失.僅在啟用有限領取戰利品日記時適用.預設: 1
Sandbox_BurdJournals_LootJournalMaxClaim.cn: 玩家可从单本破旧, 血迹斑斑或诅咒奖励日记中成功领取多少奖励的全局上限, 达到后日记即消失.仅在启用有限领取战利品日记时适用.默认值: 1

Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxRecipesPerJourna.en: Maximum number of recipes that can be recorded in a single journal. Set to 0 for unlimited. Heavily modded games can have 400+ magazine recipes.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxRecipesPerJourna.ch: 單本日記可記錄的最大配方數量.設為 0 表示無上限.模組較多的遊戲可能有 400 個以上的雜誌配方.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxRecipesPerJourna.cn: 单本日记可记录的最大配方数量.设为0表示无上限.模组较多时可能有超过400个杂志配方.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxSkillsPerJournal.en: Maximum number of skills that can be recorded in a single journal. Set to 0 for unlimited. Vanilla game has ~30 skills.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxSkillsPerJournal.ch: 單本日記可記錄的最大技能數量.設為 0 表示無上限.原版遊戲約有 30 個技能.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxSkillsPerJournal.cn: 单本日记可记录的最大技能数量.设为0表示无上限.原版游戏约有30个技能.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxTraitsPerJournal.en: Maximum number of traits that can be recorded in a single journal. Set to 0 for unlimited. Vanilla game has ~50 grantable traits.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxTraitsPerJournal.ch: 單本日記可記錄的最大特質數量.設為 0 表示無上限.原版遊戲約有 50 個可授予特質.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_MaxTraitsPerJournal.cn: 单本日记可记录的最大特质数量.设为0表示无上限.原版游戏约有50个可解锁特质.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_OtherMods.ch: 日記 - 其他模組相容
Sandbox_BurdJournals_OtherMods.cn: 日记 - 其他模组兼容

Sandbox_BurdJournals_PenUsesPerLog_toolt.en: Pen durability consumed when logging skills (1-10).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PenUsesPerLog_toolt.ch: 記錄技能時消耗的筆耐久值 (1-10).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PenUsesPerLog_toolt.cn: 记录技能时消耗的钢笔/铅笔耐久值 (1-10).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_PersistDROnErase_to.en: When enabled, erasing/restoring and re-writing a journal keeps diminishing-returns read progress instead of resetting it.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PersistDROnErase_to.ch: 啟用後, 清空/復原日記並重新書寫內容時, 會保留其收益遞減的閱讀進度, 而非重置為初始狀態.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PersistDROnErase_to.cn: 启用后, 清空/恢复日记并重新书写内容时, 会保留其收益递减的阅读进度, 而非重置为初始状态.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM.en: Maximum characters allowed on each personal journal note page. Longer pages increase saved journal payload size.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM.ch: 每個個人日記筆記頁允許的最大字元數.頁面越長, 儲存的日記資料量越大.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM.cn: 每个个人日记笔记页允许的最大字符数.更长页面会增加保存的日记数据大小.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM.en: Maximum number of writable note pages in a personal journal. Higher limits allow longer roleplay notes but increase saved journal payload size.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM.ch: 個人日記中可書寫的最大筆記頁數.更高上限允許更長的角色扮演筆記, 但會增加儲存的日記資料量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_PlayerJournalNotesM.cn: 个人日记中可书写的最大笔记页数.更高上限允许更长的角色扮演笔记, 但会增加保存的日记数据大小.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSkillAffects.ch: 閱讀技能影響學習速度
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSkillAffects.cn: 阅读技能影响学习速度

Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSkillAffects.en: Higher reading skill levels reduce learning time when absorbing from journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSkillAffects.ch: 更高等級的閱讀技能可減少從日記中領悟內容的耗時.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSkillAffects.cn: 更高等级的阅读技能可减少从日记中学习内容的耗时.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedBonus_t.en: Speed bonus per reading skill level (0.1 = 10% faster per level, max 100% at level 10).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedBonus_t.ch: 每級閱讀技能提供的速度加成 (0.1 = 每級快 10%, 10 級時最高加成 100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedBonus_t.cn: 每级阅读技能提供的速度加成 (0.1 = 每级快10%, 10级时最高加成100%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordBatchSize_too.en: How many skills/traits/recipes to record in a single action when using 'Record All' or 'Record Tab'. Higher values complete faster but can cause heavy multiplayer/server desync on busy servers. Set to 1 for classic one-at-a-time behavior. Default: 15
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordBatchSize_too.ch: 使用「全部記錄」或「標籤頁記錄」功能時, 單次操作可記錄的技能/特質/配方數量.數值越高完成速度越快, 但在繁忙伺服器上可能造成嚴重的多人/伺服器不同步.設為 1 則恢復經典的逐個記錄模式.預設: 15
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordBatchSize_too.cn: 使用“全部记录”或“标签页记录”功能时, 单次操作可记录的技能/特质/配方数量.数值越高完成速度越快, 但在繁忙服务器上可能造成严重的多人/服务器不同步, 设为1则恢复经典的逐个记录模式, 默认: 15.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordHoursSurvived.en: Allow players to record their survival time in journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordHoursSurvived.ch: 允許玩家在日記中記錄自己的生存時長.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordHoursSurvived.cn: 允许玩家在日记中记录自己的生存时长.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordZombieKills_t.en: Allow players to record their zombie kill count in journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordZombieKills_t.ch: 允許玩家在日記中記錄自己擊殺殭屍的數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RecordZombieKills_t.cn: 允许玩家在日记中记录自己击杀丧尸的数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireEraserToEras.en: Require an eraser to wipe clean journal contents.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireEraserToEras.ch: 需要橡皮擦才能擦除日記內容.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireEraserToEras.cn: 需要橡皮擦才能擦除日记内容.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireLightForJour.en: When enabled, opening journals and reading/writing journal actions require enough light, following vanilla reading darkness rules.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireLightForJour.ch: 啟用後, 開啟日記, 閱讀或書寫日記的操作皆需要足夠光源, 遵循遊戲原版的閱讀亮度規則.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequireLightForJour.cn: 启用后, 打开日记, 阅读或书写日记的操作均需要足够光源, 遵循游戏原版的阅读亮度规则.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequirePenToWrite_t.en: Require a pen or pencil to log skills in a clean journal.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequirePenToWrite_t.ch: 需要鋼筆或鉛筆才能在乾淨日記中記錄技能.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RequirePenToWrite_t.cn: 需要钢笔或铅笔才能在干净日记中记录技能.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RespawnWithExisting.en: Deprecated: Respawn with Existing Player Journal
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RespawnWithExisting.ch: 已棄用: 使用現有玩家日記重生
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RespawnWithExisting.cn: 已停用: 使用现有玩家日记重生

Sandbox_BurdJournals_RespawnWithExisting.en: Deprecated and no longer active. Existing filled journal restoration is disabled because it can create unsafe duplicate UUID and world-state edge cases. Use Spawn with Blank Player Journal instead.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RespawnWithExisting.ch: 此選項已棄用且不再生效.由於可能產生不安全的 UUID 重複與世界狀態邊緣案例, 已停用現有寫滿日記的還原功能.請改用「出生時攜帶空白玩家日記」.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_RespawnWithExisting.cn: 此选项已停用且不再生效.为避免 UUID 重复和世界状态问题, 已关闭现有写满日记的恢复功能.请改用《出生时携带空白玩家日记》.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillBookMultiplier.en: Maximum XP multiplier from skill books when absorbing skills from Worn and Bloody journals. Default 2x prevents overpowered early-game progression. Set to 16 to allow full skill book multipliers. Does not affect Player Journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillBookMultiplier.ch: 從破舊和血跡斑斑日記中領悟技能時, 技能書的最大 XP 乘數.預設 2x 可防止遊戲早期成長過於強力.設為 16 可允許完整的技能書乘數.不影響玩家日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillBookMultiplier.cn: 从破旧和血迹斑斑日记中领悟技能时, 技能书的最大 XP 乘数.默认 2x 可防止游戏早期成长过于强力.设置为 16 以允许完整的技能书乘数.不影响玩家日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillBookMultiplier.en: When enabled, skill book XP multipliers (from reading skill books) will apply to XP absorbed from Worn and Bloody journals ONLY. Player Journals are not affected. The multiplier is capped by the setting below.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillBookMultiplier.ch: 啟用後, 技能書 XP 乘數 (來自閱讀技能書)將僅套用於從破舊和血跡斑斑日記領悟的 XP.玩家日記不受影響.乘數受下方設定限制.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SkillBookMultiplier.cn: 启用后, 技能书 XP 乘数 (来自阅读技能书)将仅适用于从破旧和血迹斑斑日记领悟的 XP.玩家日记不受影响.乘数受以下设置限制.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SpawnWithBlankPlaye.ch: 出生時攜帶空白玩家日記
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SpawnWithBlankPlaye.cn: 出生时携带空白玩家日记

Sandbox_BurdJournals_SpawnWithBlankPlaye.en: Give each new character a blank player journal, including replacement characters created after death.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SpawnWithBlankPlaye.ch: 為每個新角色提供一本空白玩家日記, 包括死亡後重新建立的角色.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_SpawnWithBlankPlaye.cn: 为每个新角色提供一本空白玩家日记, 包括死亡后重新创建的角色.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalForgetCh.en: Chance for worn journals to include a special forget slot when worn forget slots are enabled.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalForgetCh.ch: 啟用破舊日記遺忘槽時, 破舊日記包含特殊遺忘槽的機率.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalForgetCh.cn: 启用破旧日记遗忘槽时, 破旧日记包含特殊遗忘槽的概率.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxRecip.en: Maximum number of magazine recipes that can spawn on a single worn journal (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxRecip.ch: 單本破舊日記可生成的最大雜誌配方數量 (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxRecip.cn: 单本破旧日记可生成的最大杂志配方数量 (1-5).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxSkill.en: Maximum skills in world-found worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxSkill.ch: 世界中拾取的破舊日記包含的最多技能數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxSkill.cn: 世界中拾取的破旧日记包含的最多技能数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxTrait.en: Maximum number of traits that can spawn on a worn journal (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxTrait.ch: 破舊日記可生成的最多特質數量 (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxTrait.cn: 破旧日记可生成的最多特质数量 (1-5).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxXP.ch: 破舊日記最大 XP/技能
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxXP.cn: 破旧日记最大 XP/技能

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxXP_to.en: Maximum XP per skill in worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxXP_to.ch: 破舊日記中每項技能的最大 XP.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMaxXP_to.cn: 破旧日记中每项技能的最大 XP.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinSkill.en: Minimum skills in world-found worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinSkill.ch: 世界中拾取的破舊日記包含的最少技能數量.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinSkill.cn: 世界中拾取的破旧日记包含的最少技能数量.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinTrait.en: Minimum number of traits that can spawn on a worn journal when traits roll succeeds (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinTrait.ch: 破舊日記特質判定成功時的最少特質數量 (1-5).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinTrait.cn: 破旧日记特质判定成功时的最少特质数量 (1-5).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinXP.ch: 破舊日記最小 XP/技能
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinXP.cn: 破旧日记最小 XP/技能

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinXP_to.en: Minimum XP per skill in worn journals.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinXP_to.ch: 破舊日記中每項技能的最低 XP.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalMinXP_to.cn: 破旧日记中每项技能的最低 XP.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalNoteChan.en: Chance for newly spawned worn journals to include a generated read-only note page.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalNoteChan.ch: 新生成的破舊日記包含隨機生成的唯讀筆記頁的機率.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalNoteChan.cn: 新生成的破旧日记包含生成式只读笔记页的概率.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalRecipeCh.en: Chance for worn journals to spawn with recipes (0-100%). Set to 0% to prevent recipes from spawning on new journals. Worn journals have a lower chance than bloody.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalRecipeCh.ch: 破舊日記包含雜誌配方的機率 (0-100%).設為 0% 可防止新日記生成配方.破舊日記的機率低於血跡斑斑的日記.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalRecipeCh.cn: 破旧日记包含杂志配方的概率 (0-100%).设为 0% 可防止新日记生成配方.破旧日记的概率低于血迹斑斑的日记.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalSpawnCha.en: Chance for worn journals to appear in world containers (0.1-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalSpawnCha.ch: 破舊日記在世界容器中出現的機率 (0.1-100%).
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalSpawnCha.cn: 破旧日记在世界容器中出现的概率 (0.1-100%).

Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalTraitCha.en: Chance for worn journals to spawn with traits (0-100%). Set to 0% (default) for classic behavior where only bloody journals have traits.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalTraitCha.ch: 破舊日記包含特質的機率 (0-100%).設為0%(預設)則保持經典模式, 僅血跡斑斑日記有特質.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_WornJournalTraitCha.cn: 破旧日记包含特质的概率 (0-100%).设为0%(默认)则保持经典模式, 仅血迹斑斑日记有特质.

Sandbox_BurdJournals_XPRecoveryMode_tool.en: How journal XP recovery is handled. Full Recovery returns 100% of stored XP, while Diminishing Returns reduces repeated reads.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_XPRecoveryMode_tool.ch: 決定日記 XP 如何恢復.全額恢復會返還已儲存 XP 的 100%, 而收益遞減會降低重複閱讀的收益.
Sandbox_BurdJournals_XPRecoveryMode_tool.cn: 决定日记 XP 如何恢复.全额恢复会返还已存储 XP 的 100%, 而收益递减会降低重复阅读的收益.

Sandbox_ETW_BodyBiteContribution_tooltip.en: Severity assigned to each current bite. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier. Any resulting wound infection is not counted separately.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBiteContribution_tooltip.ch: 分配給每處目前咬傷的嚴重度. 受傷系統每10遊戲分鐘加入一次此值. 恢復系統每分鐘檢查一次, 若治療狀態保持不變, 會在10分鐘內獲得或失去此總值, 然後再套用其治療倍率. 由此造成的傷口感染不會另外計算.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBiteContribution_tooltip.cn: 分配给每处当前咬伤的严重度. 受伤系统每10游戏分钟加入一次此值. 恢复系统每分钟检查一次, 若治疗状态保持不变, 会在10分钟内获得或失去此总值, 然后再应用其治疗倍率. 由此造成的伤口感染不会另外计算.

Sandbox_ETW_BodyBurnContribution_tooltip.en: Severity assigned to each current burn. The Injuries System adds this value every ten in-game minutes. The Healer System checks every minute and, if treatment stays unchanged, gains or loses this total value over ten minutes before applying its treatment multiplier.
Sandbox_ETW_BodyBurnContribution_tooltip.ch: 分配給每處目前燒傷的嚴重度. 受傷系統每10遊戲分鐘加入一次此值. 恢復系統每分鐘檢查一次, 若治療狀態保持不變, 會在10分鐘內獲得或失去此總值, 然後再套用其治療倍率.

Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystemCounter_too.en: Total base duration value from completed food-eating actions required to gain Fast Eater. Slow Eater can be lost after half this value. Interrupted actions do not count, and eating-speed traits do not change the amount recorded.
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystemCounter_too.ch: 獲得快食者所需的已完成進食動作基礎時長總值. 達到此值的一半後即可失去慢食者. 被中斷的動作不計入, 且進食速度特質不會改變記錄的數值.
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystemCounter_too.cn: 获得快食者所需的已完成进食动作基础时长总值. 达到此值的一半后即可失去慢食者. 被中断的动作不计入, 且进食速度特质不会改变记录的数值.

Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystem_tooltip.en: Tracks the base duration values of completed food-eating actions. Interrupted eating actions, drinking, and smoking do not count. At half of the configured counter you can lose Slow Eater; at the full counter you can gain Fast Eater.
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystem_tooltip.ch: 追蹤已完成進食動作的基礎時長值. 被中斷的進食動作, 飲水和吸菸皆不計入. 計數器達到設定值的一半時可失去慢食者; 達到全值時可獲得快食者.
Sandbox_ETW_EatingSpeedSystem_tooltip.cn: 追踪已完成进食动作的基础时长值. 被中断的进食动作, 饮水和吸烟皆不计入. 计数器达到设定值的一半时可失去慢食者; 达到全值时可获得快食者.

Sandbox_ETW_FastEaterSpeed_tooltip.en: Percentage by which the Fast Eater trait reduces the time needed to eat food. Does not affect drinking or smoking. Set to 0 to disable the speed bonus.
Sandbox_ETW_FastEaterSpeed_tooltip.ch: 快食者特質減少進食所需時間的百分比. 不影響飲水或吸菸. 設為0可停用此速度加成.
Sandbox_ETW_FastEaterSpeed_tooltip.cn: 快食者特质减少进食所需时间的百分比. 不影响饮水或吸烟. 设为0可禁用此速度加成.

Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemCounter_tooltip.en: Sets both the positive and negative limit of the Healer System counter. Gain Slow Healer at -66%, lose Slow Healer at -33%, lose Fast Healer at +33%, and gain Fast Healer at +66%. Characters who start with Slow Healer or Fast Healer begin at the corresponding negative or positive maximum.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemCounter_tooltip.ch: 設定恢復系統計數器的正負上限. 在-66%獲得恢復慢, 在-33%失去恢復慢, 在+33%失去恢復快, 在+66%獲得恢復快. 開局帶有恢復慢或恢復快的角色會從對應的負向或正向最大值開始.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemCounter_tooltip.cn: 设定恢复系统计数器的正负上限. 在-66%获得缓慢恢复, 在-33%失去缓慢恢复, 在+33%失去快速恢复, 在+66%获得快速恢复. 开局带有缓慢恢复或快速恢复的角色会从对应的负向或正向最大值开始.

Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemNeedsAttentionMu.en: Multiplies severity-weighted Healer System progress lost from wounds that need attention. The system checks every in-game minute and applies one tenth of the configured ten-minute total each time. Wound severity is configured with the shared Body Contribution settings.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemNeedsAttentionMu.ch: 對因需要處理的傷口而失去的恢復系統進度 (依嚴重度加權) 套用此倍率. 系統每遊戲分鐘檢查一次, 每次套用所設定10分鐘總值的十分之一. 傷口嚴重度由共用的身體貢獻值設定調整.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemNeedsAttentionMu.cn: 对因需要处理的伤口而失去的恢复系统进度 (依严重度加权) 应用此倍率. 系统每游戏分钟检查一次, 每次应用所设定10分钟总值的十分之一. 伤口严重度由共用的身体贡献值设置调整.

Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemProperlyTendedMu.en: Multiplies severity-weighted Healer System progress from properly tended wounds. The system checks every in-game minute and applies one tenth of the configured ten-minute total each time. Wound severity is configured with the shared Body Contribution settings.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemProperlyTendedMu.ch: 對妥善處理的傷口帶來的恢復系統進度 (依嚴重度加權) 套用此倍率. 系統每遊戲分鐘檢查一次, 每次套用所設定10分鐘總值的十分之一. 傷口嚴重度由共用的身體貢獻值設定調整.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystemProperlyTendedMu.cn: 对妥善处理的伤口带来的恢复系统进度 (依严重度加权) 应用此倍率. 系统每游戏分钟检查一次, 每次应用所设定10分钟总值的十分之一. 伤口严重度由共用的身体贡献值设置调整.

Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystem_tooltip.en: Controls Slow Healer and Fast Healer based on how consistently the character tends current wounds. Wound care is checked every in-game minute. Clean bandages, stitches, and valid splints add severity-weighted progress; dirty bandages, embedded glass or bullets, untreated bleeding, burns needing washing, uncovered wounds, and splintable fractures without a splint remove it. Contribution settings describe the total progress produced over ten in-game minutes when the wound state remains unchanged. Wound infection is not counted, and having no tracked wounds does not change the counter.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystem_tooltip.ch: 根據角色照料目前傷口的持續程度控制恢復慢和恢復快. 傷口照護每遊戲分鐘檢查一次. 乾淨的繃帶, 縫合和有效的夾板會增加依嚴重度加權的進度; 髒繃帶, 嵌入的玻璃或子彈, 未處理的流血, 需要清理的燒傷, 未包紮的傷口, 以及可上夾板卻未上夾板的骨折會減少進度. 貢獻值設定描述的是傷口狀態保持不變時, 10遊戲分鐘內產生的總進度. 傷口感染不計入, 沒有被追蹤的傷口時計數器也不會變化.
Sandbox_ETW_HealerSystem_tooltip.cn: 根据角色照料当前伤口的持续程度控制缓慢恢复和快速恢复. 伤口护理每游戏分钟检查一次. 干净的绷带, 缝合和有效的夹板会增加依严重度加权的进度; 脏绷带, 嵌入的玻璃或子弹, 未处理的流血, 需要清理的烧伤, 未包扎的伤口, 以及可上夹板却未上夹板的骨折会减少进度. 贡献值设置描述的是伤口状态保持不变时, 10游戏分钟内产生的总进度. 伤口感染不计入, 没有被追踪的伤口时计数器也不会变化.

Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemCounter_toolti.en: Sets both the positive and negative limit of the Injuries System counter. Trait thresholds are percentages of this value: gain Thin Skinned at -66%, lose Thin Skinned at -33%, lose Thick Skinned at +33%, and gain Thick Skinned at +66%. Characters who start with Thin Skinned or Thick Skinned begin at the corresponding negative or positive maximum.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemCounter_toolti.ch: 設定受傷系統計數器的正負上限. 特質門檻為此值的百分比: 在-66%獲得薄皮, 在-33%失去薄皮, 在+33%失去皮厚, 在+66%獲得皮厚. 開局帶有薄皮或皮厚的角色會從對應的負向或正向最大值開始.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemCounter_toolti.cn: 设定受伤系统计数器的正负上限. 特质门槛为此值的百分比: 在-66%获得细皮嫩肉, 在-33%失去细皮嫩肉, 在+33%失去皮糙肉厚, 在+66%获得皮糙肉厚. 开局带有细皮嫩肉或皮糙肉厚的角色会从对应的负向或正向最大值开始.

Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemPassiveCounter.en: How much is subtracted from the Injuries System counter every ten in-game minutes while the character has none of the tracked injuries.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemPassiveCounter.ch: 角色沒有任何被追蹤的傷勢時, 每10遊戲分鐘從受傷系統計數器扣除的數值.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystemPassiveCounter.cn: 角色没有任何被追踪的伤势时, 每10游戏分钟从受伤系统计数器扣除的数值.

Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystem_tooltip.en:
Controls Thin Skinned and Thick Skinned based on the injuries your character sustains over time. Every ten minutes, each current tracked injury increases the counter by its configured contribution, fortifying the character over time. Having no tracked injuries instead decreases the counter. Wound infection does not contribute. The counter is clamped between the negative and positive maximum.
Thin Skinned is gained at -66%, Thin Skinned is lost at -33%, Thick Skinned is lost at +33%, and Thick Skinned is gained at +66%.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystem_tooltip.ch:
根據角色長期承受的傷勢控制薄皮和皮厚. 每10分鐘, 每處目前被追蹤的傷勢會依其所設貢獻值增加計數器, 使角色隨時間變得更強韌. 沒有被追蹤的傷勢時計數器則會減少. 傷口感染不計入貢獻. 計數器會被限制在負向與正向最大值之間.
在-66%獲得薄皮, 在-33%失去薄皮, 在+33%失去皮厚, 在+66%獲得皮厚.
Sandbox_ETW_InjuriesSystem_tooltip.cn:
根据角色长期承受的伤势控制细皮嫩肉和皮糙肉厚. 每10分钟, 每处当前被追踪的伤势会依其所设贡献值增加计数器, 使角色随时间变得更强韧. 没有被追踪的伤势时计数器则会减少. 伤口感染不计入贡献. 计数器会被限制在负向与正向最大值之间.
在-66%获得细皮嫩肉, 在-33%失去细皮嫩肉, 在+33%失去皮糙肉厚, 在+66%获得皮糙肉厚.

Sandbox_ETW_SlowEaterSpeed_tooltip.en: Percentage by which the Slow Eater trait increases the time needed to eat food. Does not affect drinking or smoking. Set to 0 to disable the slowdown.
Sandbox_ETW_SlowEaterSpeed_tooltip.ch: 慢食者特質增加進食所需時間的百分比. 不影響飲水或吸菸. 設為0可停用此減速效果.
Sandbox_ETW_SlowEaterSpeed_tooltip.cn: 慢食者特质增加进食所需时间的百分比. 不影响饮水或吸烟. 设为0可禁用此减速效果.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.en: Ideal Weight Lose Grace Period Hours Speed Multiplier
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.ch: 理想體重失去寬限時數累積倍率
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.cn: 理想体重失去宽限小时数累积倍率

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.en: How fast you earn 'grace period' hours that later are used up before you lose the trait if you're not between 75-85 weight. Default multiplier of 1 earns you 1 grace period hour for every 12h of keeping weight 78-82 (Basically 0.0834 grace hours for each 1h). Higher multiplier = faster gain of grace hours. Lower multiplier = slower gain of grace hours.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.ch: 你累積寬限時數的速度; 當體重不在75-85之間時, 這些時數會先被消耗, 用完後才會失去此特質. 預設倍率1代表體重維持在78-82時, 每12小時累積1小時寬限時數 (即每1小時約累積0.0834小時). 倍率越高, 寬限時數累積越快; 倍率越低則累積越慢.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightDyn.cn: 你积累宽限小时数的速度; 当体重不在75-85之间时, 这些小时数会先被消耗, 用完后才会失去此特质. 默认倍率1代表体重保持在78-82时, 每12小时积累1小时宽限小时数 (即每1小时约积累0.0834小时). 倍率越高, 宽限小时数积累越快; 倍率越低则积累越慢.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.cn: 理想体重失去宽限小时数上限

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.ch: 計數器上最多可以累積多少小時; 當你的體重不在75-85之間時, 這些時數會先被消耗, 之後才會失去理想體重特質
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightLos.cn: 计数器上最多可以积累多少小时; 当你的体重不在75-85之间时, 这些小时数会先被消耗, 之后才会失去理想体重特质

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_IdealWeightObt.cn: 在积累获得此特质的进度期间, 你的体重可以有多少小时不在78-82之间而不重置进度. 每游戏内一小时检查一次.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.en: This is internal counter that needs to be reached before you get the trait. Each injury below belt adds to counter every 10 min. Deep Wound > Laceration > Burn/Fracture > Scratch > Bleeding. For example, having burns on 1 bodypart below belt would result in getting around +2.3 on counter in 24h. Having 1 fracture gives around +3 in 24h.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.ch: 這是需要達到的內部計數器數值, 達到後才會獲得此特質. 腰部以下的每處傷勢每10分鐘都會增加計數. 深傷口 > 撕裂傷 > 燒傷/骨折 > 抓傷 > 流血. 例如, 腰部以下1個身體部位有燒傷, 24小時內計數器約+2.3; 有1處骨折則24小時約+3.
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_UnwaveringCoun.cn: 这是需要达到的内部计数器数值, 达到后才会获得此特质. 腰部以下的每处伤势每10分钟都会增加计数. 深伤口 > 撕裂伤 > 烧伤/骨折 > 抓伤 > 流血. 例如, 腰部以下1个身体部位有烧伤, 24小时内计数器约+2.3; 有1处骨折则24小时约+3.

Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_WildsmanKill.ch: 荒野求生長矛擊殺要求
Sandbox_MoreTraitsDynamic_WildsmanKill.cn: 荒野求生长矛击杀要求

Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_AddToLoot_toolti.en: If Always Show is disabled, tick this so that Military Issued sensor will appear in loot. Wearing these will show the UI. Requires restart
Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_AddToLoot_toolti.ch: 若停用「一律顯示」，勾選此項可讓軍用感測器出現在戰利品中。穿戴後即可顯示 UI。需要重新啟動
Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_AddToLoot_toolti.cn: 若禁用“始终显示”，勾选此项可让军用传感器出现在战利品中。穿戴后即可显示 UI。需要重启

Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_AlwaysShowElemen.en: Always UI. This requires the PhunSprintersUI mod active. Probably makes sense to disable to moodle option if using this. Requires restart
Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_AlwaysShowElemen.ch: 一律顯示 UI。需啟用 PhunSprintersUI 模組。使用此選項時建議停用情緒圖示選項。需要重新啟動
Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_AlwaysShowElemen.cn: 始终显示 UI。需启用 PhunSprintersUI 模组。使用此选项时建议禁用情绪图标选项。需要重启

Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_ShowRNCToolTip_t.en: If set to true (and you have Rewarding Night Combat mod installed), this will add their tooltip to the moon element, thereby enabling you to remove theirs
Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_ShowRNCToolTip_t.ch: 若啟用（且已安裝 Rewarding Night Combat 模組），會將其提示加入月亮元件，讓你可以移除該模組原本的提示
Sandbox_PhunSprintersUI_ShowRNCToolTip_t.cn: 若启用（且已安装 Rewarding Night Combat 模组），会将其提示加入月亮元素，让你可以移除该模组原本的提示

Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodleOnlyWhen.ch: 僅在有風險時顯示情緒圖示
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodleOnlyWhen.cn: 仅在有风险时显示情绪图标

Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodleOnlyWhen.en: Only show moodle when sprinters can spawn
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodleOnlyWhen.ch: 僅在奔跑者可能生成時顯示情緒圖示
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodleOnlyWhen.cn: 仅在奔跑者可能生成时显示情绪图标

Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodle_tooltip.en: Show moodle with information about current sprinter risks
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodle_tooltip.ch: 顯示情緒圖示，呈現目前奔跑者風險資訊
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_ShowMoodle_tooltip.cn: 显示情绪图标，呈现当前奔跑者风险信息

Sandbox_PhunSprinters_VersionKey_tooltip.en: Advanced setting. Change to reset zed ModData for some reason or another
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_VersionKey_tooltip.ch: 進階設定。修改此值可視需要重置殭屍的 ModData
Sandbox_PhunSprinters_VersionKey_tooltip.cn: 高级设置。修改此值可视需要重置丧尸的 ModData

Sandbox_PhunZones_LoadDefaults_tooltip.en: Load basic vanilla zones. Untick if you do not want to use the vanilla zones PZ ships with (eg you are using a total custom map)
Sandbox_PhunZones_LoadDefaults_tooltip.ch: 載入基本的原版區域。若不想使用 PZ 內建的原版區域（例如你使用的是完全自訂的地圖），請取消勾選
Sandbox_PhunZones_LoadDefaults_tooltip.cn: 加载基本的原版区域。若不想使用 PZ 自带的原版区域（例如你使用的是完全自定义的地图），请取消勾选

Sandbox_PhunZones_ProcessOnClient_toolti.en: Untick to process client zone location changes on server side (requires server restart)
Sandbox_PhunZones_ProcessOnClient_toolti.ch: 取消勾選以改由伺服器端處理客戶端的區域位置變更（需要重新啟動伺服器）
Sandbox_PhunZones_ProcessOnClient_toolti.cn: 取消勾选以改由服务器端处理客户端的区域位置变更（需要重启服务器）

Sandbox_PhunZones_PvPMode_tooltip.en: Enabled = PvP mode if forced on if player enters a zone with PvP option ticked, Otherwise it gets forced off (default behaviour). Toggle = same as default, but allows player to toggle PvP on/off within PvP areas. Disabled = prevents PhunZones from doing anything with PvP (eg you are managing via another mod)
Sandbox_PhunZones_PvPMode_tooltip.ch: 啟用 = 玩家進入勾選了 PvP 選項的區域時強制開啟 PvP 模式，否則強制關閉（預設行為）。切換 = 與預設相同，但允許玩家在 PvP 區域內自行開關 PvP。停用 = 讓 PhunZones 完全不干涉 PvP（例如你透過其他模組管理）
Sandbox_PhunZones_PvPMode_tooltip.cn: 启用 = 玩家进入勾选了 PvP 选项的区域时强制开启 PvP 模式，否则强制关闭（默认行为）。切换 = 与默认相同，但允许玩家在 PvP 区域内自行开关 PvP。禁用 = 让 PhunZones 完全不干涉 PvP（例如你通过其他模组管理）

Sandbox_PhunZones_ShowZoneChange_tooltip.en: Display the welcome marquee when entering a new zone
Sandbox_PhunZones_ShowZoneChange_tooltip.ch: 進入新區域時顯示歡迎橫幅
Sandbox_PhunZones_ShowZoneChange_tooltip.cn: 进入新区域时显示欢迎横幅

Sandbox_PhunZones_VehicleTracking_toolti.en: Use the location of the last vehicle entered as the players current location. Ideal for RV Interiors
Sandbox_PhunZones_VehicleTracking_toolti.ch: 以玩家最後進入的車輛位置作為玩家目前位置。適合搭配 RV Interiors 使用
Sandbox_PhunZones_VehicleTracking_toolti.cn: 以玩家最后进入的车辆位置作为玩家当前位置。适合搭配 RV Interiors 使用

Sandbox_PhunZones_ZedUpdateFrequency_too.en: The number of seconds between updating zeds with zone information used for removing them and by other mods. The higher the number, the less resource intensive it is
Sandbox_PhunZones_ZedUpdateFrequency_too.ch: 更新殭屍區域資訊的間隔秒數，用於移除殭屍及供其他模組使用。數值越高，資源消耗越低
Sandbox_PhunZones_ZedUpdateFrequency_too.cn: 更新丧尸区域信息的间隔秒数，用于移除丧尸及供其他模组使用。数值越高，资源消耗越低

Sandbox_TWF_QOL_ForagingIgnoreCollateral.ch: 搜尋: 忽略附帶種子
Sandbox_TWF_QOL_ForagingIgnoreCollateral.cn: 搜寻: 忽略附带种子

Sandbox_TWF_QOL_ForagingIgnoreCollateral.en:
When enabled, wild crops found through foraging still give the food item, but the automatically generated extra seed items are ignored.
Multiplayer: controlled by the server and applied authoritatively.
Singleplayer: Mod Options override this Sandbox setting.
Sandbox_TWF_QOL_ForagingIgnoreCollateral.ch:
啟用後, 透過搜尋找到的野生作物仍會給予食物本身, 但會忽略自動產生的額外種子物品.
多人遊戲: 由伺服器控制並強制套用.
單人遊戲: 模組選項會覆蓋此沙盒設定.
Sandbox_TWF_QOL_ForagingIgnoreCollateral.cn:
启用后, 通过搜寻找到的野生作物仍会给予食物本身, 但会忽略自动生成的额外种子物品.
多人游戏: 由服务器控制并强制应用.
单人游戏: 模组选项会覆盖此沙盒设置.

Sandbox_TchernoLib_UselessZombies_toolti.en: When a zombie loses a target it's forbidden to attack (e.g. an infected player), it's marked useless to stop it re-detecting that target - but useless zombies also stop wandering. Off: zombies keep wandering normally, but may walk towards a forbidden target without attacking it.
Sandbox_TchernoLib_UselessZombies_toolti.ch: 當殭屍失去一個被禁止攻擊的目標時 (例如已感染的玩家), 會被標記為無用, 以免再次偵測到該目標 - 但無用殭屍也會停止遊蕩. 關閉: 殭屍照常遊蕩, 但可能會朝被禁止攻擊的目標走去而不攻擊它.
Sandbox_TchernoLib_UselessZombies_toolti.cn: 当丧尸失去一个被禁止攻击的目标时 (例如已感染的玩家), 会被标记为无用, 以防其再次侦测到该目标 - 但无用丧尸也会停止游荡. 关闭: 丧尸照常游荡, 但可能会朝被禁止攻击的目标走去而不攻击它.

Tooltip_BlankSurvivalJournal.en: A blank journal ready to record your survival knowledge.
Tooltip_BlankSurvivalJournal.ch: 一本空白日記, 可用於記錄你的生存知識.
Tooltip_BlankSurvivalJournal.cn: 一本空白日记, 可用于记录你的生存知识.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_AbsorbAllDesc.en: Claim all remaining skills and traits at once. Journal will dissolve.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_AbsorbAllDesc.ch: 一次領取所有剩餘的技能和特質, 日記會隨之消失.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_AbsorbAllDesc.cn: 一次性领取所有剩余的技能和特质, 日记会随之消失.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_AbsorbAllSkillsTrai.ch: 全部領悟 (%1項技能, %2項特質)
Tooltip_BurdJournals_AbsorbAllSkillsTrai.cn: 全部领悟 (%1项技能, %2项特质)

Tooltip_BurdJournals_BlankJournalDesc.en:
Opens the journal to record your survival progress.
Requires a writing tool.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_BlankJournalDesc.ch:
開啟日記以記錄你的生存進度.
需要書寫工具.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_BlankJournalDesc.cn:
打开日记以记录你的生存进度.
需要书写工具.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_BloodyDesc.en: Rare find! May contain valuable traits.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_BloodyDesc.ch: 稀有發現!可能包含珍貴特質.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_BloodyDesc.cn: 稀有发现!可能包含珍贵特质.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalDesc.en: A journal from a fallen survivor. Contains skills and traits that can be absorbed.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalDesc.ch: 一本逝去的倖存者留下的日記, 包含可領悟的技能和特質.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_BloodyJournalDesc.cn: 一本陨落幸存者留下的日记, 包含可领悟的技能和特质.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ClaimAllDesc.en:
Opens journal and claims all available skills.
This will take time based on your reading speed.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ClaimAllDesc.ch:
開啟日記並領取所有可用技能.
耗時長短取決於你的閱讀速度.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ClaimAllDesc.cn:
打开日记并领取所有可用技能.
耗时长短取决于你的阅读速度.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ClaimingInfo.en: Claiming sets your XP to the recorded level (if higher).
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ClaimingInfo.ch: 領取會將你的經驗值設為記錄的等級 (如果更高).
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ClaimingInfo.cn: 领取会将你的经验值设为记录的等级 (如果更高).

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyDesc.en:
Open the crafting menu (B) to find 'Clean and Convert Bloody Journal'.
Requires: Soap, Cloth, Leather, Thread, Needle, Tailoring Lv1.
WARNING: Destroys any remaining rewards!
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyDesc.ch:
開啟製作選單 (B鍵) 找到「清潔並轉換血跡斑斑日記」選項.
所需材料: 肥皂, 布料, 皮革, 線團, 縫針, 縫紉1級.
警告: 此操作會銷燬日記中所有未領取的獎勵!
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyDesc.cn:
打开制作菜单 (B键)找到“清洁并转换血迹斑斑日记”选项.
所需材料: 肥皂, 布料, 皮革, 线团, 缝针, 缝纫1级.
警告: 此操作会销毁日记中所有未领取的奖励!

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyToClea.en: Use crafting to convert this bloody journal to a clean personal journal.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyToClea.ch: 透過製作將這本血跡斑斑的日記轉換為乾淨的個人日記.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertBloodyToClea.cn: 通过制作将这本血迹斑斑的日记转换为干净的个人日记.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToClean.ch: 重新裝訂為個人生存日記
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToClean.cn: 重新装订为个人生存日记

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToCleanDesc.en: Rebind this worn journal into a clean blank survival journal for personal use. Requires tailoring supplies.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToCleanDesc.ch: 將這本破舊日記重新裝訂為乾淨的空白生存日記, 供個人使用. 需要縫紉相關材料.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ConvertToCleanDesc.cn: 将这本破旧日记重新装订为干净的空白生存日记, 供个人使用.需要缝纫相关材料.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightFaint.en: The seal hints at a specific kind of punishment.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightFaint.ch: 封印暗示著某種特定的懲罰.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightFaint.cn: 封印暗示着某种特定的惩罚.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.en: Insight: the blood is hiding something.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.ch: 洞察: 血跡正在掩藏某些東西.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.cn: 洞察: 血迹正在隐藏某些东西.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.ch: 一本普通的血跡斑斑日記.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedInsightHidden.cn: 一本普通的血迹斑斑日记.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedJournalDesc.en: Breaking the seal marks the first reader, but unlocks a richer bloody reward journal.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedJournalDesc.ch: 打破封印會標記首位閱讀者, 同時解鎖一本獎勵更豐厚的血跡斑斑日記.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_CursedJournalDesc.cn: 打破封印会标记首位阅读者, 同时解锁一本奖励更丰厚的血迹斑斑日记.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_DisassembleDesc.en:
Tear apart this journal for materials.

You will receive:
  2x Paper
  1x Leather Strips
Tooltip_BurdJournals_DisassembleDesc.ch:
拆解這本日記以回收製作材料.

你將獲得:
 2x 紙張
 1x 皮革條
Tooltip_BurdJournals_DisassembleDesc.cn:
拆解这本日记以回收制作材料.

你将获得:
 2x 纸张
 1x 皮条

Tooltip_BurdJournals_EraseContentsDesc.en:
Erases all recorded data, returning the journal to a blank state.
Requires an eraser.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_EraseContentsDesc.ch:
清除所有記錄的資料, 將日記恢復為空白狀態.
需要橡皮擦.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_EraseContentsDesc.cn:
清除所有记录的数据, 将日记恢复为空白状态.
需要橡皮擦.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_HiddenCursedInsight.en: A bloody journal with a few odd details.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_HiddenCursedInsight.ch: 一本血跡斑斑的日記, 有幾處奇怪的細節.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_HiddenCursedInsight.cn: 一本血迹斑斑的日记, 有几个奇怪细节.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_IlliterateDesc.en: You cannot read or write. Journals are useless to you.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_IlliterateDesc.ch: 你不識字. 日記對你毫無用處.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_IlliterateDesc.cn: 你不识字.日记对你毫无用处.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedEraser.en: Requires an eraser to wipe the contents.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedEraser.ch: 需要橡皮擦才能擦除內容.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedEraser.cn: 需要橡皮擦才能擦除内容.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedPen.en: Requires a pen or pencil to write.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedPen.ch: 需要鋼筆或鉛筆才能書寫.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedPen.cn: 需要钢笔或铅笔才能书写.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaning.en: This journal is too worn to read.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaning.ch: 這本日記過於破舊, 無法閱讀.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaning.cn: 这本日记过于破旧, 无法阅读.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaningDesc.en: Use soap and cloth to clean it, duct tape to patch it, or leather strips to rebind it.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaningDesc.ch: 可使用肥皂和布料清潔, 膠帶修補, 或皮革條重新裝訂.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsCleaningDesc.cn: 可使用肥皂和布料清洁, 胶带修补, 或皮条重新装订.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsConvertMateria.en: Requires: Leather Strips + Thread + Needle + Tailoring Lv1
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsConvertMateria.ch: 所需材料: 皮革條 + 線團 + 縫針 + 縫紉技能1級
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsConvertMateria.cn: 所需材料: 皮条 + 线团 + 缝针 + 缝纫技能1级

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsGluePaper.cn: 所需材料: 胶水 + 纸张

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsLeatherBinding.ch: 所需材料: 皮革條 + 線團 + 縫針

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsSoapCloth.ch: 所需材料: 肥皂 + 破布或洗碗布
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NeedsSoapCloth.cn: 所需材料: 肥皂 + 破布或洗碗布

Tooltip_BurdJournals_NoPermissionClaim.en: You don't have permission to claim from this journal.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NoPermissionClaim.ch: 你沒有權限從此日記領取.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_NoPermissionClaim.cn: 你没有权限从此日记领取.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedNote.en: This will take time based on your reading speed.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedNote.ch: 耗時長短取決於你的閱讀速度.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_ReadingSpeedNote.cn: 耗时长短取决于你的阅读速度.

Tooltip_BurdJournals_RecordProgressDesc.en:
Opens journal to record your current skills and traits.
Recorded values are only updated if your current level is higher.
Tooltip_BurdJournals_RecordProgressDesc.ch:
開啟日記以記錄你目前的技能和特質.
