我把 {{skillName}} 和 {{recipeName}} 塞在分拣箱后面.如果 {{openerName}} 找到那个红色的信封, 别拆开它.有些愿望值得保有隐私.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRad.en:
A carol played over the emergency band for eleven minutes before a man cut in and begged someone to let his family through the fence at the checkpoint. He had the right papers, he said. He had the stamps, the signatures, the proof that they weren't sick, weren't exposed, weren't any threat to containment. Then the song started again from the first verse like nothing had happened, like no one had been begging, like the music was more important than the voice or the voice had never been there at all or the voice had been part of the song, another instrument, another note in the arrangement.

Santa heard it. So did {{authorName}}. So did {{dangerNoun}}, who don't celebrate holidays but do recognize patterns, do respond to sound, do gather where the music is loudest because the living gather there too, trying to hear, trying to know, trying to feel normal for the length of a song they remember from before the smell came, before the phones died, before the fences went up and the world got small and dangerous and full of teeth.

The gift for {{openerName}} is {{skillNameA}}, which is practical, and {{recipeName}}, which is comforting in a way that music used to be comforting, in the way that warm food and full bellies used to be comforting. There's advice too: turn the dial if the music knows your name. If the carol seems to be addressing you directly, if the lyrics change to include details they shouldn't know, if the third verse mentions your mother's name or your childhood address or the thing you did at the roadblock that you haven't told anyone about - turn it off. Unplug the radio. Remove the batteries. Break the antenna if you have to.

The music is supposed to be a signal that help exists, that order persists, that someone is still broadcasting and therefore someone is still receiving and therefore the connection between people hasn't been completely severed. But the Knox Event changed what broadcasts mean. Changed what signals are for. The music might be bait. The music might be a trap dressed in nostalgia. The music might be {{omenNoun}} learning to sing. Take the gift of {{skillNameA}} and {{recipeName}} and be careful what you listen to. Not all carols are holy. Not all presents are freely given. Not all silence is safe, but some silences are safer than the wrong kind of sound.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRad.ch:
一首頌歌在緊急頻段上播了十一分鐘, 然後一個男人插了進來, 哀求有人放他的家人通過檢查站的圍欄.他說, 他有正確的文件.他有印章, 有簽名, 有能證明他們沒生病, 沒有暴露, 對封鎖隔離毫無威脅的證據.然後那首歌又從第一段重新開始, 彷彿什麼都沒發生過, 彷彿沒有人哀求過, 彷彿音樂比那個聲音更重要, 或者那個聲音從來就不存在, 又或者那個聲音本來就是歌曲的一部分——另一件樂器, 編曲裡的另一個音符.

聖誕老人聽見了.{{authorName}}也聽見了.{{dangerNoun}}也聽見了——它們不過節, 卻懂得辨認模式, 會對聲音起反應, 會聚集在音樂最響亮的地方, 因為活人也聚集在那裡, 想聽清楚, 想弄明白, 想在一首歌的長度裡感覺自己還正常——那是他們記憶中的歌, 來自那股氣味出現之前, 電話斷訊之前, 圍欄立起之前, 來自世界變得狹小, 危險, 滿是利齒之前.

給{{openerName}}的禮物是{{skillNameA}}, 它很實用; 還有{{recipeName}}, 它帶來的安慰, 就像音樂曾經帶來的安慰, 就像熱食與飽足曾經帶來的安慰.另外還有一句忠告: 如果音樂知道你的名字, 就轉開旋鈕.如果頌歌似乎在直接對你說話, 如果歌詞變了, 多出它們不該知道的細節, 如果第三段唱出你母親的名字, 你童年的住址, 或你在路障那裡做過, 卻從未告訴任何人的那件事——關掉它.拔掉收音機的插頭.取出電池.必要的話, 折斷天線.

音樂本該是一種訊號, 代表救援存在, 秩序仍在, 代表有人還在廣播, 因此有人還在接收, 因此人與人之間的連結尚未完全斷絕.但諾克斯事件改變了廣播的意義.改變了訊號的用途.音樂可能是誘餌.音樂可能是披著懷舊外衣的陷阱.音樂可能是{{omenNoun}}在學著唱歌.收下{{skillNameA}}和{{recipeName}}這份禮物, 並小心你所聆聽的東西.並非所有頌歌都神聖.並非所有禮物都是白白給的.並非所有寂靜都安全, 但有些寂靜, 比錯誤的聲音安全得多.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRad.cn:
一首颂歌在紧急频段上播放了十一分钟, 然后一名男子插了进来, 恳求有人让他的家人穿过检查站的栅栏.他说, 他有正确的文件.他有印章, 签名, 证明他们没有生病, 没有暴露, 对封锁隔离没有任何威胁.然后这首歌又从第一节开始, 就像什么都没发生过, 就像没有人乞求过, 就像音乐比声音更重要, 或者声音根本不存在, 或者声音已经成为歌曲的一部分, 另一种乐器, 编曲中的另一个音符.

圣诞老人听到了.{{authorName}} 也是如此.{{dangerNoun}}也是如此, 他们不庆祝节日, 但确实识别模式, 确实对声音做出反应, 确实聚集在音乐最响亮的地方, 因为活着的人也聚集在那里, 试图听到, 试图了解, 试图在一首歌的长度里感觉正常——那是他们记忆中的歌, 来自气味到来之前, 电话没电之前, 栅栏升起之前, 世界变得狭小, 危险和充满牙齿之前.

送给{{openerName}}的礼物是{{skillNameA}}, 它很实用, 还有{{recipeName}}, 它让人感到安慰, 就像音乐曾经让人感到安慰一样, 就像温暖的食物和饱腹的感觉曾经让人感到安慰一样.还有建议: 如果音乐知道你的名字, 请转动旋钮.如果颂歌似乎直接对你说话, 如果歌词更改为包含他们不应该知道的细节, 如果第三节提到你母亲的名字或你童年的地址或你在路障那里所做的, 却没有告诉任何人的事情 - 将其关闭.拔掉收音机的插头.取出电池.如有必要, 请折断天线.

音乐应该是一种信号, 表明帮助存在, 秩序持续存在, 有人仍在广播, 因此有人仍在接收, 因此人与人之间的联系还没有完全切断.但诺克斯事件改变了广播的含义.改变了信号的用途.音乐可能是诱饵.音乐可能是一个披着怀旧气息的陷阱.音乐可能是{{omenNoun}}在学着唱歌.接受 {{skillNameA}} 和 {{recipeName}} 的礼物, 小心你听到的内容.并非所有颂歌都是神圣的.并非所有礼物都是免费赠送的.并非所有的沉默都是安全的, 但有些沉默比错误的声音更安全.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.en:
The rooftop lights came on by timer every night even after the family vanished. They blinked red, green, red, green, inviting every hungry thing on the block to admire the season.

{{authorName}} climbed up to cut the cord and found this journal under the shingles. I added {{entryNameA}} because survival needs maintenance, and {{entryNameB}} because beauty is dangerous when it glows.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.ch:
即使那家人消失之後, 屋頂的燈每晚仍會按定時器亮起.紅, 綠, 紅, 綠地閃爍著, 邀請街區裡每一個飢餓的東西前來欣賞佳節.

{{authorName}}爬上去剪斷電線, 在屋瓦下發現了這本日記.我加上了{{entryNameA}}, 因為生存需要維護; 也加上了{{entryNameB}}, 因為美麗一旦發光就變得危險.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.cn:
即使家人失踪后, 屋顶的灯每天晚上都会按定时器亮起.它们闪烁着红, 绿, 红, 绿的光芒, 邀请街区里所有饥饿的东西来欣赏这个季节.

{{authorName}} 爬上去割断电线, 并在木瓦下发现了这本日记本.我添加了 {{entryNameA}}, 因为生存需要维护, 添加了 {{entryNameB}}, 因为美丽发光时是危险的.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.en:
The rooftops were safer before the snow started showing footprints that led nowhere, that circled the same HVAC unit three times, that stopped at the edge and started again on the next building over without any way to cross between. Santa saw {{authorName}} leave {{supplyNoun}} under a plastic tree in the break room and call it tradition. That counts, apparently. That counts as Christmas.

For {{openerName}}, these pages are wrapped in the only paper I could find - a map of the county that is wrong now, that shows roads that are ditches and bridges that are ash and towns that are just collections of buildings where the doors don't lock because the locks were removed by people who needed the metal for other purposes. {{entryNameA}} is for surviving the cold, which is the enemy that doesn't stop, that doesn't sleep, that seeps into everything through gaps you didn't know were gaps. {{entryNameB}} is for surviving the living, who are colder than the snow in ways that don't have thermometers.

The ribbon is from the mall. I found it in a store that sold things nobody needed anymore - scented candles, decorative pillows, picture frames for family photos that would never be taken. The ribbon was in a clearance bin, which is funny because everything is clearanced now, everything is reduced to take, to use, to survive. Nothing has a price because money is just paper that isn't as useful as this paper, paper with {{skillNameA}} written on it, paper with {{recipeName}} in the margins, paper that might keep you alive when the scented candles are burned out and the decorative pillows are stuffed with straw for insulation.

Santa is a story. I know that. You know that. But stories are what we have when the facts are too cold to touch. So this is a story about a gift, about {{openerName}} finding something useful in a useless season, about the dead outside not getting in, about the cold outside not winning. It's a true story, or it will be if you make it true. Open the pages. Learn the lessons. Stay alive. That's the miracle. That's the gift. That's the whole story, right there.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.ch:
在雪地開始浮現那些腳印之前, 屋頂本來還算安全——那些腳印不通往任何地方, 繞著同一台空調主機轉了三圈, 在屋緣停住, 又在隔壁那棟樓的屋頂上重新出現, 中間卻沒有任何能跨過去的路.聖誕老人看見{{authorName}}把{{supplyNoun}}留在休息室的塑膠聖誕樹下, 還稱之為傳統.顯然, 這樣也算數.這樣就算是聖誕節了.

給{{openerName}}: 這些書頁包在我唯一找得到的紙裡——一張如今已經不準的郡地圖, 上面畫的道路成了溝渠, 橋樑成了灰燼, 城鎮只剩一堆一堆的房子, 門都鎖不上, 因為鎖被那些需要金屬做其他用途的人拆走了.{{entryNameA}}是為了在寒冷中活下來——寒冷是不會停, 不會睡的敵人, 會從你不知道是縫隙的縫隙滲進一切.{{entryNameB}}是為了在活人手中活下來——他們比雪更冷, 冷得沒有溫度計量得出來.

緞帶來自購物中心.我在一家賣著再也沒人需要的東西的店裡找到它——香氛蠟燭, 裝飾抱枕, 再也不會拍的全家福相框.緞帶躺在清倉特價箱裡, 這很諷刺, 因為如今一切都在清倉, 一切都被賤價處理, 只為了拿走, 用掉, 活下去.沒有東西還有價格, 因為錢不過是紙, 還不如這疊紙有用——寫著{{skillNameA}}的紙, 頁邊記著{{recipeName}}的紙, 在香氛蠟燭燒盡, 裝飾抱枕被塞進稻草充當隔熱材料之後, 還可能讓你活下去的紙.

聖誕老人是個故事.我知道.你也知道.但當事實冷得無法觸碰時, 我們擁有的就只剩故事.所以這是一個關於禮物的故事, 關於{{openerName}}在無用的季節裡找到有用的東西, 關於外頭的死者進不來, 關於外頭的寒冷贏不了.這是個真實的故事——或者說, 只要你讓它成真, 它就會是.翻開書頁.學會這些教訓.活下去.那就是奇蹟.那就是禮物.整個故事, 就在這裡.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideRoo.cn:
在雪开始显出那些脚印之前, 屋顶还比较安全——那些脚印无处可去, 绕着同一个暖通空调装置转了三圈, 停在边缘, 又在下一座建筑物上重新开始, 中间没有任何可以跨越的路.圣诞老人看到 {{authorName}} 将 {{supplyNoun}} 留在休息室的塑料树下, 并称其为传统.显然, 这样也算数.这就算是圣诞节了.

对于{{openerName}}, 这些页面被包裹在我能找到的唯一一张纸中——一张现在错误的县地图, 它显示道路是沟渠, 桥梁是灰烬, 城镇只是建筑物的集合, 门没有锁, 因为锁被需要金属用于其他目的的人拆除了.{{entryNameA}} 是为了在寒冷中生存, 寒冷是一个不停歇, 不睡觉, 通过你不知道是缝隙的缝隙渗透到一切的敌人.{{entryNameB}} 是为了在活人手中生存, 他们比雪还冷, 冷得没有温度计能测量.

丝带来自商场.我在一家卖没人需要的东西的商店里找到了它——香薰蜡烛, 装饰枕头, 永远不会拍的家庭照片相框.丝带在一个清仓箱里, 这很有趣, 因为现在所有东西都在清仓, 一切都被降价处理, 只为了拿走, 使用, 活下去.没有什么东西有价格, 因为钱只是纸, 还没有这些纸有用——上面写着{{skillNameA}}的纸, 页边写着{{recipeName}}的纸, 当香薰蜡烛燃尽, 装饰枕头被塞满稻草用来隔热时, 还能让你活下去的纸.

圣诞老人是一个故事.我知道.你知道的.但当事实冷得无法触碰时, 我们就有了故事.所以这是一个关于礼物的故事, 关于{{openerName}}在无用的季节找到有用的东西, 关于外面的死人无法进入, 关于外面的寒冷无法获胜.这是一个真实的故事, 或者如果你把它变成真的, 它就会是真实的.打开页面.吸取教训.活着.这就是奇迹.这就是礼物.这就是整个故事, 就在那里.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideShe.en:
Someone hung stockings in the shelter because children were watching. By morning, the stockings held ration crackers, loose nails, and one note from {{survivorName}} asking Santa to bring the phones back.

I could not manage that. I could manage {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}}. If {{openerName}} finds these pages, give someone else the warm corner when you can afford it.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideShe.ch:
有人在避難所裡掛起了聖誕襪, 因為孩子們在看.到了早上, 襪子裡裝著口糧餅乾, 幾根零散的釘子, 還有一張{{survivorName}}寫的字條, 求聖誕老人把電話帶回來.

那個我辦不到.我辦得到的是{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}找到這些書頁, 在你負擔得起的時候, 把溫暖的角落讓給別人吧.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideShe.cn:
有人在避难所里挂了长袜, 因为孩子们在旁边看着.到了早上, 袜子里装着口粮饼干, 零散的钉子, 还有 {{survivorName}} 写的一张纸条, 求圣诞老人把电话带回来.

我无法做到那一点.我能做到的是 {{entryNameA}} 和 {{entryNameB}}.如果 {{openerName}} 找到这些页面, 请在你负担得起的情况下将温暖的角落留给其他人.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
Nice people share food. Useful people share knowledge. {{authorName}} tried to be both and wrote {{skillNameA}} while the house smelled like smoke.

The page on {{skillNameB}} is the better gift. {{openerName}} should take it without guilt. Surviving can be polite later.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
善良的人分享食物.有用的人分享知識.{{authorName}}想兩者兼顧, 於是在滿屋煙味中寫下了{{skillNameA}}.

關於{{skillNameB}}的那一頁是更好的禮物.{{openerName}}拿走它就是, 不必內疚.活下來之後, 再講禮貌也不遲.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
好人分享食物.有用的人分享知识.{{authorName}} 试图两者兼而有之, 并在房子闻起来有烟味时写下了 {{skillNameA}}.

关于{{skillNameB}}的那一页是更好的礼物.{{openerName}}应该毫无愧疚地接受它.幸存下来以后才能有礼貌.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
The ribbon is mostly for morale, and morale is mostly for people who haven't learned that decorations are just targets that sparkle. The real gift is {{skillNameA}}, written carefully enough for cold fingers to follow, and {{skillNameB}}, written twice because winter makes ink stubborn and survivors need redundancy.

{{openerName}} should open this before the candles burn low. A practical lesson is still a present. The paper is wrapping paper, salvaged from the mall that played carols over the sound of barricades being constructed, over the screams of people who thought holiday sales were still happening, over the slow realization that the emergency broadcast had replaced "Jingle Bells" and nobody was coming to fix it.

{{authorName}} called it a poor holiday. I call it honest. Last year there was too much, too many gifts, too much food, too much certainty that next year would be the same. This year there is {{skillNameA}}, there is {{skillNameB}}, there is the knowledge that someone cared enough to write them down before the cold or the dead or the despair took them away. That is enough. That is more than enough. That is abundance measured in usefulness instead of calories.

If {{openerName}} survives because of what is in these pages, the gift worked. Santa didn't deliver it. The elves didn't manufacture it in a workshop at the North Pole. A person wrote it, a person who was cold and scared and probably dying, a person who still thought the future deserved a chance to know things. That person was the miracle. These skills are just the proof.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
緞帶主要是為了士氣, 而士氣主要是給那些還沒學到「裝飾品只是會閃閃發光的靶子」的人.真正的禮物是{{skillNameA}}——寫得夠仔細, 凍僵的手指也能照著做; 還有{{skillNameB}}——寫了兩遍, 因為冬天讓墨水變得倔強, 而倖存者需要備份.

{{openerName}}應該在蠟燭燒短之前打開它.一堂實用的課依然是一份禮物.這紙是包裝紙, 從購物中心搶救回來的——那裡的頌歌蓋過了搭建路障的聲響, 蓋過了還以為節慶特賣仍在進行的人們的尖叫, 蓋過了眾人慢慢意識到緊急廣播已經取代《聖誕鈴聲》, 而且不會有人來修好這一切的過程.

{{authorName}}說這是個寒酸的節日.我說這叫誠實.去年什麼都太多——太多禮物, 太多食物, 太多「明年也會一樣」的篤定.今年有{{skillNameA}}, 有{{skillNameB}}, 有這樣一份認知: 在寒冷, 死亡或絕望帶走他們之前, 有人在乎得願意把這些寫下來.這就夠了.這遠遠不止夠了.這是用實用性而非熱量來衡量的富足.

如果{{openerName}}因為這些書頁裡的內容而活了下來, 這份禮物就成功了.它不是聖誕老人送來的.也不是精靈在北極的工坊裡製造的.寫下它的是一個人——一個又冷又怕, 大概快要死去的人, 一個仍然認為未來值得有機會知道這些事的人.那個人才是奇蹟.這些技能只是證明.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
丝带主要是为了士气, 而士气主要是为了那些还不知道装饰品只是闪闪发光的目标的人.真正的礼物是{{skillNameA}}, 写得足够仔细, 足以让冰冷的手指跟随, 而{{skillNameB}}, 写了两次, 因为冬天使墨水顽固, 幸存者需要冗余.

{{openerName}} 应该在蜡烛烧低之前打开它.实践课仍然是一份礼物.这张纸是包装纸, 是从商场里回收来的, 商场里播放着颂歌, 盖过了修建路障的声音, 盖过了以为节日销售仍在进行的人们的尖叫声, 盖过了人们慢慢意识到紧急广播已经取代了《铃儿响叮当》, 而没有人会来修复它的过程.

{{authorName}} 称这是一个糟糕的假期.我称之为诚实.去年有太多东西——太多的礼物, 太多的食物, 太多“明年也会一样”的确定.今年有{{skillNameA}}, 有{{skillNameB}}, 有这样一份认知: 在寒冷, 死亡或绝望带走他们之前, 有人足够在乎, 把它们写了下来.这就够了.这已经足够了.这是用有用性而不是卡路里来衡量的丰富性.

如果 {{openerName}} 由于这些页面中的内容而幸存下来, 那么这份礼物就起作用了.圣诞老人没有送来.精灵们并不是在北极的工厂里制造它的.写下它的是一个人, 一个寒冷, 害怕, 可能快要死的人, 一个仍然认为未来应该有机会了解事情的人.那个人就是奇迹.这些技能只是证明.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
Snow makes every mistake visible. The footprints that lead nowhere and then lead back. The dropped tools that mark where panic happened. The bad routes that circle the same {{noun}} three times before the person realizes they're walking in their own tracks. The panic circles around {{noun}} that show exactly where hope failed and instinct took over.

{{authorName}} learned {{skillNameA}} by watching what the snow accused them of doing wrong. Every error preserved in white, every misjudgment saved for review, every wrong turn frozen in place until spring or until the dead found the trail and added their own tracks to the record. The snow is an honest witness. The snow does not forget. The snow shows {{openerName}} exactly what happened here, and if {{openerName}} is smart, they will read the snow before they add their own story to it.

{{skillNameB}} came after dark, when the snow stopped being a teacher and started being a blanket that covered sounds and shapes and the difference between a bush and a person standing very still. I learned it by firelight in a house that wasn't mine, using tools that belonged to someone who wouldn't need them anymore, following instructions that were missing steps but had extra warnings that turned out to be more important than the missing steps.

Winter doesn't care about the holiday. December 25th is just another day when the sun sets early and the cold seeps through walls and the dead don't shiver because they don't feel anything. But people care. People need markers, need reasons to keep going, need to pretend that the calendar still means something even when the days blur together into survival. {{skillNameA}} and {{skillNameB}} are reasons. They're proof that someone was here, that someone knew things, that someone wanted you to know things too.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
雪讓每一個錯誤都無所遁形.那些不通往任何地方, 然後又折返的腳印.那些標記出恐慌發生地點的掉落工具.那些糟糕的路線, 繞著同一個{{noun}}轉了三圈, 走的人才發現自己一直踩在自己的足跡上.那些繞著{{noun}}打轉的恐慌圈, 準確地標出希望在哪裡崩潰, 本能在哪裡接管.

{{authorName}}是看著雪地指控自己犯下的錯, 才學會了{{skillNameA}}.每一個失誤都以白色保存, 每一次誤判都被存檔待查, 每一個走錯的彎都凍結在原地, 直到春天來臨, 或直到死者找到這條足跡, 把自己的腳印也添進紀錄裡.雪是誠實的見證者.雪不會忘記.雪會準確地讓{{openerName}}看見這裡發生過什麼; 如果{{openerName}}夠聰明, 就會先讀懂雪, 再把自己的故事寫上去.

{{skillNameB}}是天黑之後才來的——那時雪不再是老師, 而成了一條毯子, 蓋住聲音, 蓋住形狀, 蓋住一叢灌木與一個站著一動也不動的人之間的差別.我是在一間不屬於我的房子裡就著火光學會它的, 用著那些再也用不到工具的人留下的工具, 照著一份缺了步驟的說明做——但上面多出來的警告, 事後證明比缺掉的步驟更重要.

冬天不在乎節日.12 月 25 日不過是又一個太陽早早落下, 寒氣滲進牆壁的日子, 而死者不會發抖, 因為他們什麼也感覺不到.但人在乎.人需要標記, 需要撐下去的理由, 需要假裝日曆仍然有意義——即使日子在求生中糊成一片.{{skillNameA}}和{{skillNameB}}就是理由.它們證明有人來過這裡, 有人懂得一些事情, 有人希望你也能懂.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
雪让每一个错误都变得显而易见.那些无处可去却又会回来的脚印.掉落的工具标记了恐慌发生的位置.糟糕的路线在人们意识到他们在自己的轨道上行走之前, 绕着同一个 {{noun}} 三圈.围绕 {{noun}} 的恐慌准确地表明了希望失败和本能取而代之的地方.

{{authorName}} 通过看雪指控他们做错的事, 学会了{{skillNameA}}.每一个错误都以白色保存下来, 每一个误判都被保存以供审查, 每一个错误的转弯都被冻结在原地, 直到春天或直到死者找到踪迹并将自己的足迹添加到记录中.雪是诚实的见证人.雪不会忘记.雪准确地向{{openerName}}展示了这里发生的事情, 如果{{openerName}}很聪明, 他们会在添加自己的故事之前阅读雪.

{{skillNameB}} 是在天黑之后到来的, 那时雪不再是老师, 而是开始成为一条毯子, 覆盖声音和形状, 以及灌木丛和静止不动的人之间的区别.我在不属于我的房子里通过火光学会了它, 使用属于不再需要它们的人的工具, 遵循缺少步骤但有额外警告的说明, 这些警告比缺少的步骤更重要.

冬天不关心假期.12 月 25 日又是一天, 太阳落得很早, 寒气渗透墙壁, 死者不会发抖, 因为他们没有任何感觉.但人们关心.人们需要标记, 需要继续前进的理由, 需要假装日历仍然有意义, 即使日子在生存中模糊不清.{{skillNameA}} 和 {{skillNameB}} 就是理由.它们证明有人曾在这里, 有人知道一些事情, 有人希望你也知道一些事情.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
The stocking held no candy, only folded pages. {{skillNameA}} was tucked in the toe. {{skillNameB}} was pinned near the cuff with a bent safety pin.

{{authorName}} called it a poor holiday. I call it honest. If {{openerName}} survives because of it, the gift worked.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
聖誕襪裡沒有糖果, 只有摺好的書頁.{{skillNameA}}塞在襪尖裡.{{skillNameB}}用一根彎掉的安全別針別在襪口旁.

{{authorName}}說這是個寒酸的節日.我說這叫誠實.如果{{openerName}}因此活了下來, 這份禮物就成功了.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
袜子里没有糖果, 只有折叠的纸页.{{skillNameA}} 塞在袜尖里.{{skillNameB}} 用弯曲的安全别针别在袜口附近.

{{authorName}} 称这是一个糟糕的假期.我称之为诚实.如果 {{openerName}} 因此幸存下来, 那么这份礼物就起作用了.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.en:
Workshop rule: if it keeps someone alive, it is a toy for grownups. {{skillNameA}} belongs on the top shelf. {{skillNameB}} belongs near the door. Everything else is decoration.

{{openerName}} can unwrap the lesson now. No batteries required, no assembly except practice.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.ch:
工坊守則: 只要能讓人活命, 它就是大人的玩具.{{skillNameA}}該放在最上層的架子.{{skillNameB}}該放在門邊.其他一切都只是裝飾.

{{openerName}}現在就可以拆開這堂課了.不需要電池, 也不需要組裝——只需要練習.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSki.cn:
工作室规则: 如果它能让人活下去, 那它就是大人的玩具.{{skillNameA}} 属于顶层架子.{{skillNameB}} 属于靠近门的位置.其他一切都是装饰.

{{openerName}} 现在可以拆开这堂课了.无需电池, 除了练习之外无需组装.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSno.en:
The snowplow made it farther than the convoy. It shoved cars, luggage, and bad decisions into the ditch until the fuel died near {{noun}}. After that, winter took the road back one inch at a time.

{{openerName}} gets the useful pieces: {{skillName}} for the body, {{recipeName}} for the pot, and {{traitName}} for whatever stubborn part refuses to lie down.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSno.ch:
掃雪車比車隊走得更遠.它把汽車, 行李和糟糕的決定通通推進溝裡, 直到燃料在{{noun}}附近耗盡.在那之後, 冬天一寸一寸地把道路收了回去.

{{openerName}}得到的是有用的部分: {{skillName}}給身體, {{recipeName}}給鍋子, {{traitName}}則給你身上那個拒絕倒下的頑固部分.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSno.cn:
扫雪机比车队走得更远.它将汽车, 行李和错误的决定推入沟渠, 直到 {{noun}} 附近的燃料耗尽.此后, 冬天一寸一寸地把道路夺了回去.

{{openerName}} 获得有用的部分: {{skillName}} 给身体, {{recipeName}} 给锅, {{traitName}} 给那个拒绝躺下的顽固部分.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSou.en:
The soup kitchen kept ladling until the pot was mostly water and hope, until the ladle scraped the bottom and the sound was loud enough to make people nervous, to make them look at the door, to make them remember that hunger makes the living dangerous too, not just the dead. People said thank you like manners could keep the fever out, like please and thank you were antibodies, like gratitude was a form of PPE that you could wear over your face instead of a mask that had already been worn by someone else and never properly cleaned.

{{authorName}} wrote names on cups so the living could feel counted, so they could hold something with their identity on it even when the soup was thin and the bread was the kind that gets harder instead of softer when it sits out. The cups were from a donation drive last year, branded with a church logo and a slogan about salvation. The irony was noted but not discussed. Discussion was for people who had calories to spare on talking.

For {{openerName}}, these pages are hot soup in paper form: {{skillNameA}} first, because the body needs to be capable before the mind can be useful. {{recipeName}} second, because the mind needs to know how to feed the body even when the church donations stop and the cups run out and the only thing left is what you can make yourself from what's left in the pantries of people who don't need pantries anymore. {{traitName}} third, because surviving the holidays still counts as a miracle even when the angels are all dead and the herald angels aren't singing anything except the emergency broadcast on a loop.

If you can carry {{traitName}} without spilling it, without letting it leak out and make you vulnerable, without letting it become a burden that slows you down when you need to move - carry it. If you can't, leave it here with the cups and the names and the thin soup. Some gifts are too heavy for some people. That's not failure. That's just physics. That's just the reality of what you can hold versus what the world keeps piling on. Take what you can. Leave what you must. Keep moving. That's the gift that matters: motion, continuation, the refusal to become part of the scenery, the scenery that is increasingly full of things that don't move except to chase things that do.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSou.ch:
施粥站不停地舀著, 直到鍋裡剩下的大多是水和希望, 直到湯勺刮到鍋底, 那聲音大得讓人緊張, 讓人望向門口, 讓人想起飢餓也會讓活人變得危險——不只是死者.人們說著謝謝, 彷彿禮貌能把熱病擋在門外, 彷彿「請」和「謝謝」是抗體, 彷彿感激是一種能罩在臉上的防護裝備, 而不是一個別人戴過, 又從來沒好好清潔過的口罩.

{{authorName}}在杯子上寫下名字, 好讓活著的人覺得自己被算在內, 好讓他們即使湯很稀, 麵包放久了只會變硬不會變軟, 也能握著一件寫有自己身分的東西.杯子來自去年的募捐活動, 印著教會的標誌和一句關於救贖的標語.這份諷刺大家都注意到了, 只是沒人討論.討論是留給那些還有多餘熱量能花在說話上的人的.

給{{openerName}}: 這些書頁是紙做的熱湯: {{skillNameA}}排第一, 因為身體得先有能力, 頭腦才派得上用場.{{recipeName}}排第二, 因為頭腦得知道怎麼餵飽身體——即使教會的捐助斷了, 杯子用完了, 只剩下你能從那些再也不需要食物儲藏室的人家的儲藏室裡翻出來的東西, 自己動手做.{{traitName}}排第三, 因為就算天使全死了, 報佳音的天使除了循環播放的緊急廣播之外什麼也不唱, 能撐過節日仍然算是一樁奇蹟.

如果你能帶著{{traitName}}而不灑出來, 不讓它漏出去害你變得脆弱, 不讓它在你必須移動時成為拖慢你的負擔——那就帶上它.如果不能, 就把它和杯子, 名字, 稀湯一起留在這裡.有些禮物對某些人來說太重了.那不是失敗.那只是物理.那只是「你拿得動多少」對上「世界不斷往你身上堆多少」的現實.能拿的就拿.該留的就留.繼續前進.那才是真正重要的禮物: 移動, 延續, 拒絕成為風景的一部分——這片風景裡, 愈來愈多的東西一動也不動, 一動起來就只為了追逐會動的東西.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideSou.cn:
施粥处不停地舀着汤, 直到锅里大部分是水和希望, 直到勺子刮到锅底, 声音大得让人紧张, 让他们向门口看去, 让他们记住, 饥饿使生者也变得危险, 而不仅仅是死者.人们说“谢谢”, 就像礼貌可以把热病挡在外面一样, 就像“请”和“谢谢”是抗体, 就像感激是一种个人防护装备, 你可以戴在脸上, 而不是别人已经戴过且从未正确清洁过的口罩.

{{authorName}} 在杯子上写上名字, 这样生者就会感到被重视, 这样即使汤很稀, 面包放在外面会变得更硬而不是更软, 他们也可以拿着带有自己身份的东西.这些杯子来自去年的捐赠活动, 上面印有教堂标志和有关救赎的口号.人们注意到了这一讽刺, 但没有进行讨论.讨论是为那些有多余热量可以花在说话上的人准备的.

对于{{openerName}}, 这些页面是纸质形式的热汤: 首先是{{skillNameA}}, 因为身体需要有能力, 头脑才能有用.{{recipeName}} 其次, 因为头脑需要知道如何养活身体, 即使教堂的捐款停止了, 杯子用完了, 唯一剩下的就是你可以用那些不再需要食品储藏室的人的食品储藏室里剩下的东西来自己制作东西.{{traitName}} 第三, 因为即使天使都死了, 报佳音的天使除了循环播放的紧急广播之外什么也没唱, 在假期中幸存仍然算得上是一个奇迹.

如果你可以携带 {{traitName}} 而不会洒落它, 不会让它泄漏并让你变得脆弱, 不会让它成为你需要移动时减慢你速度的负担 - 携带它.如果你不能, 就把它和杯子, 名字还有稀汤一起留在这儿.有些礼物对某些人来说太重了.那不是失败.这只是物理学.这就是你能持有的东西与世界不断堆积的东西的现实.能拿的就拿.该留的就留.继续前进.这就是重要的礼物: 运动, 延续, 拒绝成为风景的一部分, 风景越来越充满除了追逐移动的事物之外不移动的事物.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideToy.en:
The toy store was untouched because nobody wanted to admit children still existed. We took batteries, blankets, and one stuffed rabbit that smelled like smoke. {{noun}} {{verb}} in the back room and every music box started at once.

{{openerName}} can have the notes on {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}}. Leave the toys unless you need something soft enough to remember mercy.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideToy.ch:
玩具店沒人動過, 因為沒有人願意承認孩子們還存在.我們拿走了電池, 毯子, 還有一隻聞起來帶著煙味的絨毛兔子.後面房間裡的{{noun}}{{verb}}, 每個音樂盒同時響了起來.

關於{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}的筆記就留給{{openerName}}.別動那些玩具, 除非你需要一件柔軟得足以讓人想起仁慈的東西.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideToy.cn:
玩具店没人动过, 因为没有人愿意承认孩子们还存在.我们拿走了电池, 毯子, 还有一只闻起来带着烟味的毛绒兔子.后面房间里的{{noun}}{{verb}}, 每个音乐盒都同时响了起来.

关于{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}的笔记就留给{{openerName}}.别动那些玩具, 除非你需要一件柔软得足以让人想起怜悯的东西.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideTre.en:
The tree farm smelled so normal it hurt. Pine, mud, gasoline, and somebody's old thermos coffee. We cut branches for camouflage and pretended the wreaths on the office door were not covering bullet holes.

{{survivorName}} left {{supplyNoun}} there for strangers. I left {{entryNameA}} and {{entryNameB}} for the same reason. If {{openerName}} hears bells in the rows, do not follow them.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideTre.ch:
林場的氣味平常得讓人心痛.松樹, 泥土, 汽油, 還有某人保溫瓶裡的舊咖啡.我們砍下樹枝拿來偽裝, 還假裝辦公室門上的花環沒有蓋住彈孔.

{{survivorName}}把{{supplyNoun}}留在那裡給陌生人.我出於同樣的理由留下了{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}在樹的行列間聽見鈴聲, 千萬別跟著走.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideTre.cn:
林场的气味平常得令人心痛.松树, 泥土, 汽油, 还有某人保温瓶里的旧咖啡.我们砍下树枝进行伪装, 并假装办公室门上的花环没有遮住弹孔.

{{survivorName}}把{{supplyNoun}}留在那里给陌生人.我出于同样的原因留下了{{entryNameA}}和{{entryNameB}}.如果{{openerName}}在树行间听到铃声, 千万不要跟着走.

UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideWor.en:
The workshop is not at the North Pole this year. It is any garage with a locked door, any kitchen with a sharp knife, any clinic with one clean bandage left. Good people make gifts out of whatever keeps someone breathing.

So here: {{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, and a little note saying {{exclamation}}. {{openerName}} can decide which part is festive.
UI_BurdJournals_LoreTemplate_YuletideWor.ch:
今年的工坊不在北極.它可以是任何一間鎖著門的車庫, 任何一間有一把利刀的廚房, 任何一間只剩一條乾淨繃帶的診所.好人會用任何能讓人繼續呼吸的東西來做禮物.

所以這裡有: {{entryNameA}}, {{entryNameB}}, 還有一張寫著{{exclamation}}的小紙條.哪一部分算是有節日氣氛, 就交給{{openerName}}來決定.

今年的工坊不在北极.它可以是任何一间锁着门的车库, 任何一间有一把锋利小刀的厨房, 任何一间只剩下一条干净绷带的诊所.好人会用任何能让人继续呼吸的东西来制作礼物.

UI_ETW_Help_FAQ.en: <H1> FAQ <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: How do I stop/change the sound notifications? How do I resize window? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc -> Options -> Mod Options. There are also some other options sprinkled in there <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: How do I get trait XYZ? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Hover your mouse over UI elements. There are a lot of tooltips which explain stuff. If it's still not understandable, check sandbox tooltips. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: Text in UI overlaps, how to fix? <LINE> <TEXT> A: There are some settings in Mod Options that might help. UI is designed to try to automatically account for different font sizes, but it is DESIGNED to be used with english language and Game Options -> User Interface (UI) -> Font Size set to 16px. Different languages and font sizes might cause some overlapping despite my efforts to make it auto-resize.
UI_ETW_Help_FAQ.ch: <H1> 常見問題 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 如何停止/更改聲音通知? 如何調整視窗大小? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc->選項->模組選項. 那裡也散布著一些其他選項 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 我要怎麼獲得某某特質? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 將滑鼠懸停在UI元素上. 有大量工具提示會解釋各種內容. 如果還是看不懂, 請檢視沙盒工具提示. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: UI中的文字重疊, 如何修復? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 模組選項中有一些設定可能有幫助. UI設計上會嘗試自動適應不同字型大小, 但它是以英文語言以及遊戲選項->使用者介面 (UI)->字型大小設為16px為基準設計的. 儘管我已盡力讓它自動調整大小, 不同語言和字型大小仍可能導致部分重疊.
UI_ETW_Help_FAQ.cn: <H1> 常见问题 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 如何停止/更改声音通知? 如何调整窗口大小? <LINE> <TEXT> A: Esc->选项->模组选项. 那里也散布着一些其他选项 <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: 我要怎么获得某某特质? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 将鼠标悬停在UI元素上. 有大量工具提示会解释各种内容. 如果还是看不懂, 请查看沙盒工具提示. <LINE> <LINE> <H2> Q: UI中的文字重叠, 如何修复? <LINE> <TEXT> A: 模组选项中有一些设置可能有帮助. UI设计上会尝试自动适应不同字体大小, 但它是以英文语言以及游戏选项->用户界面 (UI)->字体大小设为16px为基准设计的. 尽管我已尽力让它自动调整大小, 不同语言和字体大小仍可能导致部分重叠.
